A Look at New Movies Coming Out This Week: ‘Wicked: For Good,’ ‘Rental Family,’ and More! Michael McKinney November 18, 2025 0 Comments Table of Contents Toggle New Movies Coming Out This Week: November 17 – 23, 2025 Wicked: For Good (2025) Rental Family (2025) Rebuilding (2025) Sisu: Road to Revenge (2025) Selena Y Los Dinos: A Family Legacy (2025) The Family Plan 2 (2025) Blue Eyed Girl (2025) Which New Movies Coming Out This Week Are You Excited to Watch? Curious about the new movies lighting up screens this week? Whether you’re eager for blockbuster magic, unexpected comebacks, or moving stories inspired by real life, this week’s lineup has something for every film lover! First up, the wait is finally over! We get part two of the Wicked film series, Wicked: For Good , which continues the story of Elphaba, portrayed by Cynthia Erivo, and Glinda, played by Ariana Grande. Additionally, we also have Rental Family , a story about an American actor in Tokyo, portrayed by Brendan Fraser, who is hired to stand in as a family member. There’s no shortage of must-watch premieres right now, plus plenty of fresh faces, returning legends, and buzz from festival favorites. We have compiled the complete list below of all the new movies releasing in theaters and on streaming this week: New Movies Coming Out This Week: November 17 – 23, 2025 Photo courtesy of Universal Wicked: For Good (2025) Rating : PG Release Date : In theaters nationwide on Friday, November 21, 2025. Summary : In Wicked: For Good, Elphaba (Cynthia Erivo), the future Wicked Witch of the West, and Glinda (Ariana Grande), the Good Witch of the North, begin to embrace their roles, and a rift begins to develop between the two friends as their lives move down a path of confrontation. Oh, and a certain young woman from Kansas is about to come onto the scene. What to Watch For : Wicked: For Good will feature two new songs, both composed by Stephen Schwartz, along with ten songs from the Broadway musical. Word on the Street : Fans of the first film got excited when it was announced that Colman Domingo would portray the Cowardly Lion in the second film. My Take : I find it interesting that Bowen Yang, whose character Pfannee is not in the 2nd act of the Broadway musical, is in this film and has said that his character will “get his just desserts for his actions.” Photo courtesy of Searchlight Pictures Rental Family (2025) Rating : PG-13 Release Date : In theaters on Friday, November 21, 2025. Summary : Rental Family is about an American actor, Phillip (Brendan Fraser), who lives in Japan. His roles have recently dried up, and he takes a job at the Rental Family agency, where Phillip will play ‘stand-in’ roles in other people’s lives. Through this unique experience, Phillip discovers surprising connections and unexpected joys within his new families. What to Watch For : The film was shot on location in Japan. Word on the Street : The film has been a hit on the film festival circuit, winning awards, including the Narrative Feature Audience Award at the 2025 Middleburg Film Festival. My Take : The film is directed by Hikari, known for award-winning films 37 Seconds , Where We Begin , and Tsuyako . Photo courtesy of Bleecker Street Media Rebuilding (2025) Rating : PG Release Date : In theaters on Friday, November 21, 2025. Summary: Rebuilding follows Dusty (Josh O’Connor), the last in a long line of family ranching cowboys. After a devastating wildfire destroys much of the area, Dusty loses his ranch and home. He finds himself living in a small FEMA camp alongside other survivors of the wildfire. In this unlikely community, Dusty begins to discover new hope for himself and his daughter. What to Watch For : The cast includes Lily LaTorre, Kali Reis, Meghann Fahy, and Amy Madigan. Word on the Street : The film was shot in the San Luis Valley in Colorado, a desert plain divided by the Rio Grande. My Take : I don’t think Josh O’Connor would make a successful cowboy in real life, as he suffered frequent allergic reactions to the horses and other wildlife that were on set for the film. Photo courtesy of Sony Pictures Sisu: Road to Revenge (2025) Rating : R Release Date : In theaters on Friday, November 21, 2025. Summary : Sisu: Road to Revenge is about Aatami (Jorma Tommila), “the man who refuses to die,” as he returns to the home where his family was murdered during the war. He dismantles the home and loads it on a truck, intending to rebuild it. When the Red Army commander (Stephen Lang), who killed Aatami’s family, returns, it sets off a cross-country chase where the body count will be high and revenge will be on the mind of Aatami. What to Watch For : This is a sequel to the 2022 box-office hit Sisu. Word on the Street : The film premiered at the 2025 Fantastic Fest. My Take : The film is currently at 95% on Rotten Tomatoes, with over 20 film critic reviews. Photo courtesy of Netflix Selena Y Los Dinos: A Family Legacy (2025) Rating: PG Release Date : Premieres on Netflix on Monday, November 17, 2025. Summary : Selena Y Los Dinos: A Family Legacy is a documentary that shows Selena Quintanilla’s journey from playing at local events in South Texas to filling stadiums with the family band Selena Y Los Dinos, becoming the ‘Queen of Tejano Music.’ What to Watch For : The film is from award-winning, four-time Emmy-nominated filmmaker Isabel Castro, known for her documentaries Mija (2022) and Crossing Over: Stories of Immigration and Identity (2015). Word on the Street : The film features never-before-seen footage from Selena’s early life and interviews with family and friends. My Take : Growing up in San Antonio, I saw Selena perform many times, and I know she was destined for bigger things if she hadn’t been taken from us much too soon. Photo courtesy of Skydance The Family Plan 2 (2025) Rating : PG-13 Release Date : Premiering on Apple TV+ on Friday, November 21, 2025 Summary: The Family Plan 2 takes place when Dan (Mark Wahlberg), a former covert assassin, takes his family on a trip to Europe. His perfect family vacation falls apart when Dan’s past catches up with him again, and this time, his family knows that it’s all hands on deck to defeat the bad guys. What to Watch For : This is a sequel to the 2023 film The Family Plan. Word on the Street : The cast includes Michelle Monaghan, Zoe Colletti, Van Crosby, Kit Harington, Sidse Babett Knudsen, Reda Elazouar, and Sanjeev Bhaskar. My Take : Simon Cellan Jones, who directed Wahlberg in Arthur the King (2024) and the first The Family Plan (2022), is directing this film Photo courtesy of Quiver Blue Eyed Girl (2025) Rating : PG Release Date : In theaters on Friday, November 21, 2025 Summary: Blue Eyed Girl follows Jane (Marisa Coughlan), a forty-something woman who goes home to visit her sisters and ailing father. During her visit, Jane confronts her life choices and reflects on her unfulfilled hopes and dreams, as well as a past romance that resurfaces. What to Watch For : The film is written and produced by the lead actress, Marisa Coughlan. Word on the street : The cast includes Beau Bridges, Eliza Coupe, Freddy Rodriguez, Sam Trammell, and LisaGay Hamilton. My Take : The film was shot in Coughlan’s hometown in Minnesota. She describes the film as a ‘love letter to her hometown.’ Which New Movies Coming Out This Week Are You Excited to Watch? Below, let us know what new movies you plan to see this week! article Share this article on Talk Ali Larter brought Libertine’s hand-embroidered tailoring to Berlin on Friday, wearing the label’s ‘Body Language’ double-breasted jacket for the “Landman” Season Two premiere at Zoo Palast. Styled by Jeanann Williams, the look centered on the made-to-order piece, paired with black over-the-knee boots that appear to be suede. Cut as a long blazer, the jacket carries Libertine’s season-defining script embroidery, with lines of hand-sewn lettering placed across the front panels, sleeves and upper back. Larter shared a close-up on Instagram, writing: “The concept is abstracted lines from love poems with the long dangling beadwork strings meant to suggest unfinished lines.” The beadwork appears in mixed densities, from tightly sequined passages to wider spaced script, while the extended fringe falls well past the hem and creates a continuous vertical line over what appears to be an ultra-mini skirt or shorts. Her eye-catching premiere look came shortly after an interview with Fox News Digital, where she said she remains happy with her decision to leave Hollywood for Idaho with her husband, Hayes MacArthur. “We went for two months thinking that the kids’ schools would be reopened in California, and they weren’t,” she recalled of her move during the COVID-19 pandemic. 4 The American actress and former model wore her blonde hair down and kept her accessories minimal with diamond-drop earrings and a few rings. text: Ali Larter weighs in on her experience working on second season of 'Landman' Home latest pakistan world sports showbiz entertainment Royal Hollywood business health Sci-Tech Food Fact Check big picture Videos shows Watch LIVE TV X Home Latest Pakistan World Sports Showbiz Fact Check big picture Videos Shows LIVE TV Home Entertainment Ali Larter weighs in on her experience working on second season of 'Landman' Ali Larter gets up close and honest about her time working on the second season of Landman By Geo News Digital Desk | November 15, 2025 Ali Larter gets honest about what working on the second season of 'Landman’s been like Ali Larter, actor and former model has just shed some light on what the second season of Landman’s been like, especially with other big wigs like Demi Moore and Billy Bob Thornton working alongside her. She started by telling Reuters , “the highlight for me is working with Billy (Bob Thornton) you know I'm so lucky to work with such an extraordinary actor and you know there's not an inauthentic beat when you work with him so it keeps the show right in that spot and I think he elevates every scene and we have now Sam (Elliott) and Demi (Moore) and all these extraordinary actors and then the family Michelle (Randolph) and Jacob (Lofland)” So “I think it's the way that they cast the show and the chemistry between everyone that it's just so real you can feel it on the screen,” she also noted. However, the actor didn’t end there but also gushed over what it meant to have “a woman who's been through so many ups and downs in this business” with her to be able to ‘talk to it all about’. Because, “you know, I haven't always had so many people to be able to share the realities of what it's like to be an actress,” she said in her own words. “And, you know, she's just really gracious and really lovely and she's extremely talented,” Larter said before signing off. LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA - DECEMBER 14: Ali Larter attends the SAG Nom Comm screening of "Landman" at DGA Theater Complex on December 14, 2024 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Jon Kopaloff/Getty Images for Paramount+) The 49-year-old actress relocated to a mountainous retreat in Sun Valley, Idaho in 2022 after moving out of Hollywood. Ali has been embracing the natural life, telling People , "When I lived in LA, there were so many demands that came on top of being an actor. It's incredibly calming and grounding to live in the mountains, and we love raising our children in a rural, small town." The mom of two stars in the Paramount+ series Landman as Angela Norris - the ex-wife of Billy Bob Thornton's lead character Tommy Norris - and explained that she shares a similar dedication to her children as her alter ego. Ali Larter as Angela Norris in Landman, season 2, streaming on Paramount+. Photo Credit: Emerson Miller/Paramount+ "I would move heaven and earth for my children,” she said, adding her character, makes up her own rules, and that's so exciting to play because I'm not like that." Ali has a son, Teddy, 14, and daughter, Vivienne, 10, with her husband Hayes MacArthur. To play her “Landman” character, Ali also has to prepare physically to manage the tight dresses and bikinis Angela favors. Ali Larter as Angela Norris in season 1, episode 5 of Landman streaming on Paramount+. Photo credit: Emerson Miller/Paramount+. "I work really hard. I'm not pretending that I don't. There is no space in my mind for insecurity,” she said. “The sexiest women I know are the women that own it, so part of getting there with Angela is owning it." The “Varsity Blues” actress has to spend time away from her family as she films “Landman” in Texas and explained that she relies a lot on her actor and comedian husband during these periods. "Our love is so deep and true that it allows me to go away to work and have him as my support system,” she said of Hayes. "And then when he leaves, I hold down the fort. But he's my rock." CENTURY CITY, CA - FEBRUARY 28: Actress Ali Larter (L) and Hayes MacArthur attend the FEED Foundation/Hungry In America project benefit hosted by Vanity Fair held at Craft Los Angeles on February 28, 2010 in Century City, California. (Photo by Charley Gallay/Getty Images for Vanity Fair) But Ali always makes time to see her children while she’s working. "I'm always there for ballet recitals, graduations, parent-teacher conferences. And there's also the rule: If they ever want to come to see me, they're on a plane the next day." She added, "There are no rules I won't bend for that. I try to explain to them: You can be a mother, and you can also thrive in your career. I am living the beauty of my dreams." A woman from Cape Verde who has had a green card for at least 40 years is being held by US federal agents without a legal justification, her attorney has alleged. 48-year-old Eva Mendes, who has held a green card since she was eight, has a misdemeanor charge from 20 years ago. Who is Eva Mendes? ICE detains Cape Verde woman with green card for 40 years (Photo by JOHN MOORE / GETTY IMAGES NORTH AMERICA / Getty Images via AFP)(Getty Images via AFP) Mendes spent nearly two weeks in detention at Boston Logan International Airport. She was detained by Border Patrol agents after she had visited her mother. Who is Eva Mendes? Mendes is a grandmother who lives in Rhode Island. Her attorney, Todd Pomerleau, told Newsweek that she had missed the birth of her first grandchild while she was being held in unsuitable conditions. “This case is just another issue of unlawful immigration abuse. It's just unconstitutional depravity, is what we're dealing with,” Pomerleau said on Wednesday, November 19. “After two weeks of her detention, I still have never been given any written charges for why she's detained. She's not certain why she's detained.” Mendes was detained by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) at Logan Airport on November 5. She was returning to the US after visiting her family in Cape Verde, after the sudden loss of her brother. Pomerleau said that Mendez had not seen her mother for decades. She missed the birth of her grandchild while being held at the airport for 12 days on her return to the United States. ICE records show that Mendes was later transferred to the Cumberland County Jail in Portland, Maine. Pomerleau claimed that CBP detained his client because of her criminal history and past convictions. This includes a misdemeanor from around 20 years ago. Pomerleau said that some of the crimes are minor offenses from Mendes’ teens, which cannot be used against her. He said it was unclear why exactly DHS was holding her. A GoFundMe for Mendes says she has called the US her home for over 40 years, and describes her as a “devoted wife, a hardworking mother of six, and a woman whose kindness and determination have touched every person lucky enough to know her.” It further says that Mendes has “spent her life giving to others — raising her children with love, working tirelessly to provide for her family, and building a future rooted in faith and perseverance.” The page adds, “Eva is a longtime U.S. permanent resident with a valid green card, cleared by immigration officials prior to her departure. She does have a few old misdemeanor convictions and an open, decade-old petty case in Massachusettswith an active warrant. But none of these are violent or dangerous — Eva is not a threat to anyone. She is a mother, a wife, a neighbor, and a kindhearted woman who deserves compassion and due process. Read More | Who is Sharereh Moghadam? ICE detains woman with green card, husband says ‘she passed exam for citizenship’ Her husband Jose immediately retained an immigration attorney on November 8, and the lawyer filed a habeas petitionwith the court on November 10 to fight for her release. Despite this, Eva remains detained as of November 11, 2025, and her attorney has not yet been able to speak with her directly.” The GoFundMe is seeking donations to cover Mendes’ legal fees and costs, “and all necessary costs to secure Eva’s release and protect her right to remain in the country she’s called home for most of her life.” ‘No legal justification for doing this to her’ Federal officials generally do not detain green card holders for petty offenses. They would usually let such individuals go while holding onto their green cards pending further proceedings. Mendes, a mother of six, has worked and paid taxes in Rhode Island for years, her attorney said. DHS has not yet provided details on the case, or explained why Mendes is being held. “She's had a green card since she was in like first grade and has been living here her whole life. This is unconscionable. In what is likely to be one of the biggest residential buys in the UK this year, the Star Wars creator is set to move to St John's Wood. The house, which was previously owned by a city lawyer, was purchased off market in September, Bloomberg reported. Lucas, 81, is reportedly unhappy with Donald Trump 's decisions in the US and is looking to spend more time in the UK. Last year, the filmmaker hosted an A-list party for Joe Biden and fellow Democratic supporters ahead of the election. The sale of the home comes after Silicon Valley investor Matt Cohler recently bought a £22 million house in Notting Hill. It is the largest purchase since fashion designer Tom Ford bought an £80 million mansion in Chelsea last year. While Lucas has never publicly criticised the President, he has joined a growing list of liberal A-listers deciding to make the move to the UK. Star Wars creator George Lucas has bought a £40 million mansion in London as he plots a move away from Trump's America Ellen DeGeneres and her wife Portia de Rossi made a quick exit after Trump's election victory and vowed to never return. Ryan Gosling and his wife Eva Mendes also made the move alongside America Ferrera, who fled the US in search of the 'best opportunities' for her children in the UK. The so-called 'Donald Dash' has been backed up by Home Office figures this week which revealed that applications for UK citizenship soared in the last quarter of 2024, rising 40 per cent year on year. In fact more than 6,100 US citizens applied last year, the most since records began two decades ago and 26 per cent more than in 2023. One Notting Hill estate agent, who revealed the amount of wealthy American families they are moving in has 'skyrocketed' since Trump, previously said: 'We moved a Marvel actress into a house very near here in the last week.' Courtney Love and Minnie Driver have also made the move across the Atlantic since the election last year. The newest deal was brokered by Savills, who advised the vendor and Aylesford International, who advised the director. Lucas has left behind his 2,500-acre ranch in Northern California dubbed 'Skywalker Ranch', which he purchased for $28 million in 2019. Ellen DeGeneres and Portia de Rossi made a swift exit out of the US for The Cotswolds in Britain Ryan Gosling and his wife Eva Mendes are among those who have left the US for the UK Read More EXCLUSIVE Meet the Donald Dashers: How the rich and famous are fleeing the US for Notting Hill over Trump The ranch includes a massive main house, a man-made lake dubbed Lake Ewok and Skywalker Sound, a 153,000-square-foot facility that includes a 300-seat movie theater. The purchase has come as a rare high point in the luxury property market after stamp duty increases and the abolition of the non-dom tax status caused a slump. Transactions of more than £5 million were down by 41 per cent from the same time last year. The luxury market could face more problems in the near future as Rachel Reeves plots more tax rises. Lucas famously sold the rights to Stars Wars to Disney for a staggering $4billion in 2012. At the time of the monumental Lucasfilm sale, also including his company's Industrial Light & Magic and the rights to Indiana Jones, Lucas compared parting with Star Wars to losing a family member. However, after selling the Star Wars rights to Disney, Lucas didn't hold back in expressing his dissatisfaction with The Force Awakens, the first film in the franchise following the sale. In a 2015 interview with Empire Magazine, Lucas admitted he wasn't happy with the film, stating that Disney 'wanted to make a retro movie' and didn't follow his planned direction for the series. He also mentioned that he felt the film was too similar to the original trilogy, saying, 'They wanted to make a movie for the fans. They decided they didn't want to use the stories I created.' text: Eva Mendes denies moving to the UK with husband Ryan Gosling, kids November 27, 2025 3:21 PM हिंदी Home Latest National International Business Entertainment Science/Tech Sports Health/Medicine Video Subscribe Search Eva Mendes denies moving to the UK with husband Ryan Gosling, kids IANS November 4, 2025 3:51 PM Share on | Los Angeles, Nov 4 (IANS) Hollywood actress Eva Mendes, who is also the wife of Hollywood star Ryan Gosling, is calling out fake news again. The actress has denied reports which stated that she and her husband have moved their family abroad. On Monday, November 3 (Pacific Standard Time), the actress confirmed that she, her longtime partner and their two daughters, Esmeralda, 11, and Amada, 9, have not moved to England, reports ‘People’ magazine. Media reports earlier stated that the family of four moved from the U.S. to London. In response, the actress posted a photo of the article to her Instagram Stories, and denied the move, writing, "WRONG again @dailymail”. Eva Mendes, 51, confessed that though she’s been loving her time in London, she “can't wait to get back home and celebrate the @dodgers World Series championship. Go Dodgers”. As per ‘People’, the actress' statement follows the October rumors that she and Gosling, 44, purchased a home in North London and that Esmeralda and Amada were enrolled in school in London. The family’s current stay in London coincides with Ryan Gosling's role in the latest ‘Star Wars’ film, ‘Star Wars: Starfighter’. While Eva Mendes is by his side supporting his latest acting job, she revealed last year that she “was never in love with acting”. "I don't mean this in a self-deprecating way, but I wasn't a great actress”, she told The Times in October 2024. “I had my moments when I worked with really great people”. Despite the opportunity to work with great co-stars, she said that she had been offered “some pretty s***** roles”. "That's all they would say at the beginning, 'she's too ethnic for this, too ethnic for that’. It was so crazy. Because around SoFlo, there are a couple of spots serving art, with a side of carbs. Forget dinner and a movie, instead check out these two museums, two meals and zero guilt. Julie Ann Emery as Casey in “Hitch”: “Did you ever hear of this guy that they call the date doctor?” Eva Mendes as Sara in “Hitch”: “Urban myth.” Julie Ann Emery as Casey in “Hitch”: “Really?” Eva Mendes as Sara in “Hitch”: “Absolutely.” A date doctor like “Hitch” is not necessary to plan a date in SoFlo because there are tons of options, like dinner and a museum. Daniel Florit: “I think it’s a good way to meet somebody if it’s a first date. It’s a cute idea to come look at some art, have some good conversations then have some cocktails, some nice appetizers and just see where the night leads.” At the Pérez Art Museum Miami, there’s a hidden foodie gem with true masterpiece meals. Daniel Florit: “A lot of people don’t know we’re here actually. But no, this location is outstanding. Verde is an amazing restaurant located inside the Pérez Art Museum. We have an amazing menu that’s inspired by art with an amazing chef, Valerie.” And this chef gets creative with the dishes. Maritza Lacayo: “We have a tremendous privilege here where we work with our chef, who is wonderful. And she’s inspired by our shows. And so we have conversations with the kitchen, with the chef, and we tell them about the show and they create dishes that are inspired by the exhibition.” Thursday nights, the PAMM is open late to chow down, enjoy art and enjoy those Miami views. Martiza Lacayo: “I think if you’re going to come to the museum, you need to be well nourished. You can breeze through any museum, right? But we really offer opportunities for people to slow down. There’s so many works in the collection that require a little bit more contemplation so it’s great that you can come here, take a break.” Over in Allapattah, Jon & Vinny’s is turning the Rubell Museum into a full-blown carb spot. Damien Kinkela: “This is the first one outside of L.A. in the US. Jon and Vinny actually went to school in South Florida. Our hits, some of the dishes that are a little iconic to our brand, things like the spicy fusilli, the marinara braised meatballs, our pizzas, which are all fantastic.” Walking around the 30 galleries takes energy and makes the perfect combination. Alexandra Perez: “We exhibit the work from the Rubell’s private collection, which is now over 7,000 works of art. We thought it was a great fit for us. Museumgoers sometimes they want to make their museum experience a little bit more than that and have a nice dinner and cocktail after so Jon & Vinny’s can kind of do both of that.” FOR MORE INFORMATION Verde, Waterfront Restaurant and Bar at Pérez Art Museum Miami 1103 Biscayne Blvd. Miami, FL 33132 Website Jon & Vinny’s at Rubell Museum 1100 NW 23 St. Miami, FL 33127 Restaurant and museum websites Copyright 2025 Sunbeam Television Corp. text: Eva Mendes, Ryan Gosling Not Leaving Hollywood For to London News Photos Videos Black Friday Deals Kardashians Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Black Friday Deals Kardashians Royals TV Scoop Eva Mendes Slams Rumor She Moved to London With Ryan Gosling Eva Mendes debunked rumors she and husband Ryan Gosling had moved to London with their daughters Esmeralda, 11, and Amada, 9, noting that while she loved the city, she was excited to get back to L.A. By Sabba Rahbar Nov 03, 2025 9:21 PM | Updated Nov 03, 2025 11:31 PM Tags Ryan Gosling Eva Mendes Celebrities LINK COPIED! Watch : Eva Mendes Slams Rumor She Moved to London With Ryan Gosling Eva Mendes is not moving to a place beyond the Atlantic Ocean. After a report suggested she and longtime partner Ryan Gosling — who share daughters Esmeralda , 11, and Amada , 9—had left the U.S. and moved to England , the Hitch star firmly set the record straight. “WRONG again @dailymail,” Eva wrote on Instagram Stories Nov. 3 over a screenshot from the article . “Although I love my time in London, I can't wait to get back home and celebrate the @dodgers World Series championship!” The 51-year-old added, “Go Dodgers!!!” Rumors first began to swirl in October that the couple had moved to London, with Daily Mail suggesting they had purchased a home in the Hampstead neighborhood of North London and that their daughters were in school in the U.K. capital . And while Eva confirmed leaving Los Angeles is completely untrue, she has been candid about her decision to say goodbye to Hollywood and the film industry . read Eva Mendes Shares Why She’s “Extra Proud” of Ryan Gosling in Rare Shoutout "I was never in love with acting,” she admitted to The Times in October. "I don't mean this in a self-deprecating way, but I wasn't a great actress. I had my moments when I worked with really great people." According to the Ghost Rider actress, she also found that being Cuban-American meant she was often typecast as one-dimensional characters, with many thinking she wasn’t suitable for something more interesting. Todd Owyoung/NBC via Getty Images "There were some pretty s --t ty roles," she recalled. "That's all they would say at the beginning—'she's too ethnic for this, too ethnic for that.' It was so crazy. That was the constant note." And overall, Eva found that the lifestyle in Hollywood wasn’t what worked best for her. "I feel like with my kind of spirit I'd have found unhealthy behaviors anywhere," she explained. "I was so hungry for life. I still am. But I was leaving no stone unturned. I was like, 'What's over here? What's over here?'" Tim Hunter / Newspix via Getty Images Still, she’s not totally opposed to the idea of giving acting another try, especially if she has the chance to work with Ryan, 44, again as the two met while making 2012’s The Place Beyond The Pines . "That's the one thing I would love to do," Eva gushed. "He gets something out of me that's never been accessible before." For a look back at Eva and Ryan’s love story, keep reading. Focus/Kobal Their Place Beyond the Pines Ryan Gosling and Eva Mendes started dating shortly after playing a couple in their 2012 crime drama A Place Beyond the Pines . “I know that I’m with the person I’m supposed to be with," Ryan told Hello three years after the movie's release, adding that his favorite quality about his partner is that "she’s Eva Mendes." As he put it, "There’s nothing else I’m looking for." Sonia Recchia/Getty Images On Cloud Nine For Ryan, life with Eva and their daughters Esmeralda and Amada is "heaven." "It's like walking through a field of flowers every day," he gushed during a 2016 appearance on Good Morning America . "I live with angels. It's a ray of sunshine in a dark time." Paul Drinkwater/NBCUniversal via Getty Images La La Love Ryan dedicated his 2017 Golden Globes win for La La Land to Eva—and her late brother Juan Carlos Méndez Jr. —saying in his acceptance speech, "While I was singing and dancing and playing piano and having one of the best experiences I’ve ever had on a film, my lady was raising our daughter, pregnant with our second, and trying to help her brother fight his battle with cancer." "If she hadn’t have taken all that on so that I could have this experience, it would surely be someone else up here other than me today," continued Ryan. text: Cher's seven-bedroom Malibu mansion is up for sale - but you'll have to fork out a staggering sum for it | Daily Mail Online Home Showbiz TV News Lifestyle Sports Health Science Royals Money Real Estate Media U.K. Video Buyline Fashion Beauty Food & Drink Fitness & Wellbeing Love & Sex Family & Parenting Homes Horoscopes My Profile Logout Login US Edition Privacy Policy Feedback Thursday, Nov 27th 2025 4AM 55°F 7AM 52°F 5-Day Forecast Advertisement Cher's seven-bedroom Malibu mansion is up for sale - but you'll have to fork out a staggering sum for it By YOU MAGAZINE Published: 03:01 EST, 8 November 2025 | Updated: 03:43 EST, 9 November 2025 e-mail 159 shares 62 View comments On a breathtaking bluff in Malibu sits a home every bit as legendary as its owner. Cher ’s oceanfront estate- perched high above the Pacific with views stretching from Point Dume to Catalina- is an ode to design and drama. Built by architect Wallace Tutt III (the creative mind behind Gianni Versace’s Miami villa), the 16,000-square-foot mansion took almost a decade to bring to life. With its Italian Renaissance inspiration, Venetian-style arches and Moorish flourishes, the property feels part palazzo, part fantasy. Think limestone and marble from Italy and France , hand-wrought bronze doors, and tiles sourced from Spain and Morocco. Yep, even in bricks and mortar, Cher never does anything by halves. Inside, every corner tells a story. Cher’s 16,000 square-foot mansion is for sale – and yours for $75 million. It has seven bedrooms, nine bathrooms, a meditation room and gym, a courtyard with a fountain and a stunning infinity pool delivering panoramic views of the Pacific. The driveway, where Cher’s Bentley is parked, has a smart interior courtyard – the singer’s star sign, Taurus, informed her choice of vintage bronze bulls either side of the entrance. The property references Venetian palazzos, Renaissance villas of Europe and the Moorish features of the Alhambra palace. Originally designed with close friend Ron Wilson and later refreshed by A-list decorator Martyn Lawrence Bullard, (other clients include Elton John and Ru Paul), the house is a masterclass in exotic opulence. The vast rooms have Eastern-inspired painted ceilings, hand-distressed mirrored walls and Moroccan lighting. In the bedroom, silk-clad walls are hand-stencilled with patterns made from tea leaves, coffee grounds and umber pigments-a nod to the henna designs once painted on Cher’s hands during a wedding in India. Cher in her primary suite. ‘The house has been one of the greatest passions of my life,’ she says of the property, in which she has lived for the past 20 years. The living room is anchored by an 18th-century opium bed, the walnut sofas were custom designed for the space, and the table was once a Chinese bed. On the wall, just in frame, is a mandala Cher brought back from Tibet. The family room overlooks the ocean, and features a ceremonial Tibetan elephant drum on which stands a 17th-century gilded terracotta monk. The Indian day bed is the best spot from which to take in that view, and the Ottoman-style sofa is perfect for watching TV. In the kitchen, interior designer Martyn Lawrence Bullard used limestone and marble countertops, imported from Italy and France, and hardware and tiles from Morocco and Spain. A Moravian glass star is a focal point – try etsy.com for a selection. For similar silver wall tiles, try luxurytiles.co.uk. The house, built in 1999, was designed by Cher’s long-term friend and designer Ron Wilson. Martyn Lawrence Bullard, whose clients also include Elton John, Kylie Jenner and Eva Mendes, came on board 16 years later. The dining-room ceiling is made of painted tin panels; the walls are hand-trowelled plaster. The large Moroccan windows flood the space with light and spill out to an infinity-edge pool that seems to merge with the Pacific below. Cher has always described this home as one of her greatest passions-her ‘sanctuary’ and ‘fortress.’ Now, after decades of making memories there, the star has listed the estate for around £60 million ($75 million). With its mix of old-world grandeur and star style, we don't think it will be on the market long… In Cher’s bedroom, the walls are clad in raw silk and stencilled using a mixture of tea leaves and coffee grounds, blended with umber pigments to recreate henna designs painted on the star’s hands during a wedding she attended in India. The bed is 20s-vintage, inlaid with ebony and mother of pearl. ‘My bedroom has been my sanctuary,’ says Cher. Leading to the guest suites is this calm area, decorated with custom-made hanging lanterns from Mustapha Blaoui, in Marrakech. The carved bench, by Lawrence Bullard, is clad in fabric from vincentvanduysen.com. Try nkuku.com for a range of upholstered benches. The original X-Men trilogy (the one that introduced the world to Hugh Jackman as Wolverine) is usually people's go-to first pick. In second place sits Wesley Snipes' Blade trilogy, which, even with Blade: Trinity being filled with many questionable decisions, is still a great franchise. But, within that pre-MCU era sits another criminally underrated Marvel movie that's about to stream for free. Just a year before Robert Downey Jr. would play Tony Stark for the first time in Iron Man and birth the Marvel Cinematic Universe, fans got to see The Spirit of Vengeance on the big screen in Ghost Rider . Ghost Rider , starring Nicolas Cage, will soon stream for free on Tubi. The underrated pre-MCU Marvel movie will stream for free on Tubi on December 1. Released in 2007, Ghost Rider is undeniably a Marvel cult-classic. Cage, who is a lifelong comic book fan, starred as Johnny Blaze, a stunt motorcyclist who makes a deal with the devil to save his father's life. When the Devil cashes in on the bargain, Johnny gains spectral powers and is tasked with killing the Devil's son, Blackheart. The official synopsis reads: "Years ago, motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to save the life of a loved one. Now, he transforms into a fiery, avenging agent of justice at night wherever evil roams. As the only one who can walk in both worlds, Johnny is charged by Mephistopheles himself to destroy Blackheart, a demon that wants to overthrow Mephistopheles and create a worse hell than the one that currently exists." Alongside Nic Cage, the film featured a great supporting cast, including the talents of Eva Mendes, Sam Elliott, Donal Logue, Peter Fonda, and Wes Bentley as Blackheart. Mark Steven Johnson directed and wrote the movie, which was based on the Marvel Comics character created by Gary Friedrich, Roy Thomas, and Mike Ploog. Ghost Rider certainly isn't anyone's favorite Marvel movie. But the film has garnered a very strong cult following in recent years. But when Ghost Rider opened in theaters, it was a very different story. 'Ghost Rider' Was the Most Divisive Marvel Movie At the Time nicolas cage rides a motorcycle in the 2007 film ghost rider Sony Pictures Releasing That statement might seem shocking now, as it feels like many MCU projects are getting progressively worse (hopefully, Avengers: Doomsday can break that trend), but Ghost Rider was absolutely maligned when it opened in 2007. The film holds an abysmal 28% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. In the years since, audiences have become kinder to the film, granting it a 48% user score. But even recent user reviews have lambasted the film with one-star ratings. However, money talks in Hollywood. Despite the bad reviews, Ghost Rider grossed over $228 million worldwide. As a result, Ghost Rider 2: Spirit of Vengeance was quickly greenlit. If the original was divisive, the sequel was just plain bad. Both critics and audiences slammed the movie in 2012, and the sequel underperformed at the box office, grossing $132 million worldwide. Ghost Rider is one of the most famous characters from the supernatural corner of the Marvel Universe. Yet, he has only appeared in two movies and one TV show. Ghost Rider Needs To Use A Blend Of Practical Effects & VFX In The MCU It's Possible To Create Part Of Ghost Rider's Live-Action Skull & Fire With Make-Up Gabriel Luna's Robbie Reyes transforms into Ghost Rider in Agents of SHIELD An MCU Ghost Rider could reach new heights of realism by blending practical effects with CGI to create a version that feels much more tangible than the previous two. Both Nicolas Cage’s Johnny Blaze and Gabriel Luna’s Robbie Reyes relied almost entirely on digital effects, which resulted in transformations that looked a little too smooth. A base of prosthetics, enhanced with CGI, could make Ghost Rider’s infernal appearance more believable. A hybrid Ghost Rider design would be similar to the approach used by Iron Man’s early armors, Vision, and The Fantastic Four: First Steps ' Galactus. Like them, the MCU's Ghost Rider actor could wear a sculpted skull mask layered with LED fixtures embedded around the eye sockets and crown, creating dynamic lighting that actually interacts with the rest of the costume and the environment . CGI fire would then complete the illusion by turning subtle, real light reflections into a roaring blaze. Ghost Rider's Proper MCU Debut Is Long Overdue All Live-Action Ghost Riders Exist Tangentially To The MCU's Main Continuity Johnny Blaze reaches out to the camera in Agents of SHIELD episode Good Samaritan Ghost Rider is one of the biggest Marvel characters not to have properly appeared on-screen in the MCU yet. Technically, both Johnny Blaze and Robbie Reyes exist in the MCU multiverse. Nicolas Cage's Ghost Rider inhabits his own separate timeline, while Gabriel Luna's Robbie Reyes and the unknown variant of Johnny Blaze that granted him his powers both exist in Agents of SHIELD 's branch of the Sacred Timeline . Still, an Earth-616 version of the anti-hero is nowhere to be seen. By 2025, the MCU has introduced a growing list of similarly dark and supernatural-themed characters. Werewolf by Night, Man-Thing, Elsa Bloodstone, Moon Knight, Agatha Harkness, and Scarlet Witch herself are some of the MCU anti-heroes who could precede Ghost Rider's introduction. After Blade's on-screen debut and following the end of an era with Avengers: Secret Wars , there might be more room for a Ghost Rider to get his time in the spotlight. The MCU could adapt Agents of SHIELD 's Ghost Rider lore and integrate both Robbie Reyes and Johnny Blaze. But if Marvel Studios wishes to stand apart, the MCU could introduce Danny Ketch instead. Otherwise, an adaptation of Marvel Comics' current Spirits of Violence crossover could bring every major Ghost Rider together for a shared debut. This would be a somewhat similar approach to Deadpool & Wolverine 's introduction of both titular heroes and other X-Men characters in the MCU. After Blade's on-screen debut and following the end of an era with Avengers: Secret Wars , there might be more room for a Ghost Rider to get his time in the spotlight. The MCU could adapt Agents of SHIELD 's Ghost Rider lore and integrate both Robbie Reyes and Johnny Blaze. But if Marvel Studios wishes to stand apart, the MCU could introduce Danny Ketch instead. Otherwise, an adaptation of Marvel Comics' current Spirits of Violence crossover could bring every major Ghost Rider together for a shared debut. This would be a somewhat similar approach to Deadpool & Wolverine 's introduction of both titular heroes and other X-Men characters in the MCU. That's the verdict of one executive at a high-end London estate agency, which has already fielded a 'significant number' of enquiries from residents of the Big Apple. Mr Mamdani, a self-described Democratic Socialist, based his mayoral campaign on a raft of measures to ease the cost of living , which he pledged to fund with a new two per cent wealth tax on incomes over $1million (£760,140). This could hit around 34,000 households in the city, where high earners already face higher tax deductions from their pay slip than their counterparts in London due to costly state and local taxes. In fact, a salaried worker paid £1,000,000 would take home just £411,353 of their salary in New York compared to £541,786 in London, according to calculations by the Daily Mail. Becky Fatemi, an executive partner at Sotheby's International Realty in London, said she had seen enquiries for London properties rise by 28 per cent over the past month as Mamdani's poll lead grew. Your browser does not support iframes. 'We've had a significant number of New York brokers reaching out to find out what's available in London,' she told The Times . 'The sentiment among many New York residents is clear that they're considering leaving the city [and] we're seeing strong interest both in rental options and in prime and super-prime purchases in London. 'American clients don't want to live in the Middle East - they want to live in Notting Hill and South Kensington.' Yet with Ms Reeves planning to clobber the rich in her upcoming budget, wealthy New Yorkers shouldn't count on a big welcome. Potential tax hikes include a one per cent hike in income tax and a mansion tax that could levy one per cent on the value of any home over £2million. Joanna Cocking, head of private office at Hamptons, said such measures could put off rich Americans. 'I imagine we might see an uptick in wealthy New Yorkers looking to relocate to London, but with the UK [potentially] poised to introduce its own wealth tax, anyone considering relocating will need to carefully consider the implications of the budget outcomes first and how it might affect them personally,' she said. If London sees an influx of New Yorkers following Mamdani's election, it would build on an existing 'Donald Dash' of liberal Americans fleeing the US in disgust at President Trump. One recent arrival was Star Wars creator George Lucas, who has bought a huge £40million mansion in St John's Wood. The house, which was previously owned by a city lawyer, was purchased off market in September, Bloomberg reported. Lucas, 81, is reportedly unhappy with Donald Trump's decisions in the US and is looking to spend more time in the UK. The sale of the home comes after Silicon Valley investor Matt Cohler recently bought a £22million house in Notting Hill. It is the largest purchase since fashion designer Tom Ford bought an £80million mansion in Chelsea last year. While Lucas has never publicly criticised the President, he has joined a growing list of liberal A-listers deciding to make the move to the UK. Ellen DeGeneres and her wife Portia de Rossi made a quick exit after Trump's election victory and vowed to never return. Ryan Gosling and his wife Eva Mendes also made the move alongside America Ferrera, who fled the US in search of the 'best opportunities' for her children in the UK. The so-called 'Donald Dash' has been backed up by Home Office figures earlier this month which revealed that applications for UK citizenship soared in the last quarter of 2024, rising 40 per cent year on year. In fact more than 6,100 US citizens applied last year, the most since records began two decades ago and 26 per cent more than in 2023. Mandy Moore Divorced: Her History of Marriage, Explained By Author Simon Delott Published: Nov 03, 2025 at 11:36 AM • Category Mandy Moore Reading Time: 3 minutes Reading Time: 3 minutes Mandy Moore has been married and divorced, and that only covers part of her relationship highs and lows. Rocketing to fame in the late ’90s as a singer, most know her as a successful actress . But her dating and married life have had some monumental ups and downs. Here is Moore’s relationship history explained, and where things stand today. Mandy Moore attends the 29th Annual Critics Choice Awards at Barker Hangar on January 14, 2024. (Photo Credit: Frazer Harrison/Getty Images) Mandy Moore dated Vilmer Valderrama For those who remember, Mandy Moore’s most infamous romance was likely with Vilmer Valderrama. She and the That ’70s Show alum dated from 2000 until 2002, very early into her fame. Valderrama boasted in a 2006 interview that he had been the first to sleep with her, adding that she did not feel “like warm apple pie.” Talking about your ex like that is gross! Also untrue, as it turned out. Moore has stated that they have remained friends despite this inexplicable fib. Actors Wilmer Valderrama (L) and Mandy Moore talk at the after-party for United Artists’ “Saved” at the Beverly Hills Community Sports Center on May 13, 2004. (Photo Credit: Kevin Winter/Getty Images) Her most famous (on his own) romantic partner was Zach Braff Just a few years after her “Candy” music video perfectly captured the 1999-2000 aesthetic (the good and the bad, all in one place!), Moore entered a relationship with actor Zach Braff. Their romance lasted from 2004 until 2006. Two years later, in 2008, she began dating fellow musician Ryan Adams. Actors Mandy Moore and Zach Braff attend the Weinstein Co. Golden Globe after party held at Trader Vic’s on January 16, 2006. (Photo Credit: David Livingston/Getty Images) Mandy Moore and Ryan Adams married in March 2009 In February of 2009, Moore and Adams were engaged. It was not a lengthy engagement, as the two married in March of that year. Moore filed to divorce Adams in January of 2015, following six months of legal separation. In 2019, years after finalizing the split, she described Adams as emotionally abusive. She has since gone on the Dinners on Me podcast to reflect upon the ill-advised union. Going into the marriage, she feels, was a response to her parents’ divorce. Even knowing this, she admitted that she cannot believe that she made herself so small — but is glad to have learned lessons from that mistake. Mandy Moore accepts the Virtuoso Award onstage during The 2nd Annual HCA TV Awards: Broadcast & Cable at The Beverly Hilton on August 13, 2022. (Photo Credit: Kevin Winter/Getty Images) In November 2018, she married Taylor Goldsmith Later in 2015, Mandy Moore began dating another fellow musician, Taylor Goldsmith. The two became engaged in September of 2017. This engagement lasted a little longer, as they married in November of 2018. In February 2021, they welcomed son August “Gus” Harrison Goldsmith. A medically inadvisable 15 months later, in October 2022, the couple welcomed son Oscar “Ozzie” Bennett Goldsmith. Mandy Moore and Taylor Goldsmith of Dawes pose in the press room during the 67th GRAMMY Awards at Crypto.com Arena on February 02, 2025. (Photo Credit: Frazer Harrison/Getty Images) Is Mandy Moore currently married or divorced? In late September of 2024, Moore announced the birth of her daughter , Louise Everett Goldsmith. All three children share Moore and Goldsmith as parents. Mandy Moore and Taylor Goldsmith are neither divorced nor separated, and thus far show no signs of doing either. Perhaps she has found her happily ever after. Post navigation Why Has Taylor Swift Stopped Attending Travis Kelce’s Away Games? Click here to cancel reply. text: 25 Musicians Who Became Actors | British Vogue Skip to main content Open Navigation Menu Menu Search Search Fashion Beauty Arts & Lifestyle Runway Shopping News Video Vogue Shop Open Navigation Menu Menu Film 25 Musicians Who Managed To Become Genuinely Successful Actors By Vogue 13 November 2025 Facebook X Pinterest Save Story JMEnternational/Getty Images Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story This week, it was announced that Adele – a British Vogue cover star and 16-time Grammy winner – would be making her first foray into acting (aside from all the acting she’s done in her own music videos), for an upcoming Tom Ford movie. According to Deadline , the fashion designer and film-maker’s third feature film will be an adaptation of the 1982 Anne Rice novel Cry to Heaven , a drama set in 18th century Italy. And Adele won’t be the only star involved. Other names include: Hunter Schafer, Nicholas Hoult, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Colin Firth, Thandiwe Newton, Ciarán Hinds, Mark Strong, Daryl McCormack, George MacKay, Paul Bettany and Adolescence breakout star Owen Cooper (I know – star-studded!). As we wait with bated breath to see the North Londoner in action (as well as Charli xcx ’s upcoming turn in not one but eight entire movies ), we can’t help but think of some of the other performers who have made the leap from song to silver screen. Need a refresher? Scroll on for a list of musicians who have nailed the transition from singing or rapping to acting. Read More Lady Gaga Is British Vogue’s December Cover Star By Edward Enninful Lady Gaga Lady Gaga in A Star Is Born in 2018. For all the deserved attention it brought her in 2018, A Star Is Born wasn’t Lady Gaga ’s first time on screen. At 15, she appeared on a 2001 episode of The Sopranos as an (uncredited) classmate of AJ Soprano’s. Years later, after achieving pop stardom, Gaga appeared in Sin City: A Dame to Kill For in 2014 as a waitress named Bertha and later turned up in two seasons of Ryan Murphy’s American Horror Story anthology series, winning a Golden Globe for her portrayal of the Countess in American Horror Story: Hotel . And of course we mustn’t forget her turn as Patrizia Reggiani in Ridley Scott’s House of Gucci . David Bowie David Bowie in Labyrinth in 1986. David Bowie was always more than a musician. The icon – who died in 2016 – is often regarded as one of the most influential figures of the 20th century, and you’d be hard-pressed to find someone with a guitar today who wasn’t at least in some ways inspired by him. But, in among all that, he was also an actor. His big mainstream hit was obviously the 1986 fantasy musical Labyrinth , but he also appeared in everything from Tony Scott’s erotic horror film The Hunger to David Lynch’s Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me and many others. Debbie Harry Debbie Harry in Videodrome in 1983. While Debbie Harry ’s most famous turn on the silver screen was probably in David Cronenberg’s enigmatic sci-fi horror Videodrome , she’s actually been in over 30 films. From playing the coiffed antagonist Velma Von Tussle in John Waters’s cult classic Hairspray to a blink-and-you-miss-it role as a bartender in the Robert De Niro-starring Cop Land , the Blondie singer has always been the definition of “multihyphenate”. Britney Spears Britney Spears in Crossroads in 2002. Britney Spears was a natural in Crossroads , the 2002 teen road-trip movie that has since become one of those films that everyone puts on when they feel even slightly down (it’s the ultimate feel-good tonic!). At that point, she’d already released three chart-smashing albums, and would go on to release six more. Aside from a few appearances over the years, she never really continued the acting beat, although she did make a secret voice-over cameo in the 2019 film Corporate Animals as herself . Harry Styles Harry Styles in Dunkirk (2017). Harry Styles in Dunkirk in 2017. One Direction heartthrob Harry Styles made his big-screen debut in Christopher Nolan’s critically lauded (and Academy Award-winning) World War II epic Dunkirk in 2017. But it wasn’t a one-off from the world’s most famous boybander turned megastar. Also among his projects are My Policeman (with The Crown ’s Emma Corrin ) and Olivia Wilde ’s Don’t Worry Darling (with Florence Pugh ). Idris Elba Idris Elba with Caleb McLaughlin in Concrete Cowboy in 2020. Before he was a massively successful star of television and film, Idris Elba was “Big Driis,” a DJ playing across London nightclubs. Yet even as his acting career took off, Elba kept one foot in the music world, releasing his first EP, High Class Problems Vol. 1 , in 2010 ( Luther would debut on the BBC just months later) and doing a two-hour set at Coachella 2019. Will Smith Will Smith in Men in Black in 1997. Will Smith in Men in Black in 1997. Will Smith launched a highly successful – and famously curse-free – rap career with Jeff Townes under the moniker DJ Jazzy Jeff & the Fresh Prince when Smith was still a teenager. In 1986, the pair’s first single, “Girls Ain’t Nothing But Trouble,” was a hit; their 1987 debut album, Rock the House , hit the Billboard Top 200. In 1991, NBC developed a sitcom around Smith, The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air , on which he starred for six seasons before breaking onto the Hollywood A-list with films like 1995’s Bad Boys , 1996’s Independence Day , and 1997’s Men in Black . He went on to earn Oscar nominations for 2001’s Ali and 2006’s The Pursuit of Happyness . Awkwafina Awkwafina in The Farewell in 2019. Awkwafina in The Farewell in 2019. Before she lit up the screen in Ocean’s Eight (2018), Crazy Rich Asians (2018), and The Farewell (2019), Awkwafina (née Nora Lum) made her name as a rapper, going viral on YouTube with the song “My Vag” (yes, really) in 2012 and releasing her debut album, Yellow Ranger , two years later. Jennifer Hudson Jennifer Hudson in Dreamgirls in 2006. Photo: Alamy Two years after she placed seventh on American Idol , Jennifer Hudson won an Oscar for her portrayal of Effie in 2006’s Dreamgirls . She was also handpicked by Aretha Franklin to lead the biopic Respect , released back in 2021. Beyoncé Beyoncé in Austin Powers in Goldmember in 2002. ©New Line Cinema/Courtesy Everett Collection Destiny’s Child was already a big deal by the time Beyoncé starred in her first major motion picture (not counting MTV’s made-for-TV Carmen: A Hip Hopera ), playing a parody of a blaxploitation character in 2002’s Austin Powers in Goldmember . She followed that with 2003’s The Fighting Temptations and The Pink Panther in 2006 before landing one of the starring roles in the Academy Award-winning Dreamgirls from that same year. She later starred in Cadillac Records (2008), Obsessed (2009), and lent her voice to Jon Favreau’s reboot of The Lion King in 2019. Rihanna Rihanna in Ocean’s Eight in 2018. Photo: Barry Wetcher / Courtesy of Warner Brothers / Everett Collection Though Rihanna’s first movie turn was linked to her music career – she appeared in 2006’s Bring It On: All or Nothing (which also had Solange Knowles playing a cheerleader) as herself – she later took on more complex roles, like that of petty officer Cora Raikes in 2012’s Battleship , a “Moon Goddess” in 2014’s Annie , Marion Crane in the Bates Motel television series, a lounge singer in 2017’s Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets , and a hacker named Nine Ball in 2018’s Ocean’s Eight . Most recently, she appeared as Smurfette in Smurfs (2025), which she also produced. Justin Timberlake Justin Timberlake in Alpha Dog in 2006. Photo: Everett Collection Sure, Justin Timberlake began his career on the star-generating children’s television series The Mickey Mouse Club (along with Ryan Gosling, Britney Spears, Christina Aguilera, and Timberlake’s future ’N Sync bandmate JC Chasez), but things didn’t really take off for him as an actor until after his boy band career began to wane. He won two Emmys for his guest spots on Saturday Night Live and starred in films including The Social Network , Bad Teacher , Friends With Benefits , Alpha Dog , and Inside Llewyn Davis , all while maintaining a music career that’s included five studio albums, two compilation albums, and 39 singles (including 18 as a featured artist). Ice-T Ice-T on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit in 2008. Photo: Everett Collection Ice-T began his career as an underground rapper in the 1980s and was signed to Sire Records when he released his debut album Rhyme Pays in 1987. In 1991, he played a police detective in Mario Van Peebles’s film New Jack City ; later that same year, he played a gang leader in Ricochet , acting alongside Denzel Washington and John Lithgow, a performance he followed up with another part as a gang leader in 1992’s Trespass , followed by a lead role in 1994’s Surviving the Game and supporting ones in 1995’s Johnny Mnemonic and Tank Girl . He’s starred as NYPD detective turned sergeant Odafin Tutuola on the NBC police drama Law & Order: Special Victims Unit since 2000. Mandy Moore Mandy Moore in A Walk to Remember in 2002. Photo: Everett Collection In 1999, amidst the craze for pop princesses like Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera, a 15-year-old Mandy Moore delivered the pop album So Real , and it became a hit off its single “ Candy .” Film roles soon followed, including 2001’s The Princess Diaries and 2002’s A Walk to Remember , which was essentially Love Story for the early aughts with less covetable clothes. Though Moore has since enjoyed major recognition for her turn as Rebecca Pearson on This Is Us , she returned to the studio for the first time in a decade in 2019, releasing her seventh studio album, Silver Landings , in 2020. Mandy Patinkin Mandy Patinkin on Homeland in 2020. Photo: Everett Collection Mandy Patinkin is slightly out of place on this list – a graduate of Juilliard, he has always been an actor who sings – but do the people who love him in The Princess Bride , Criminal Minds , Homeland , and The Good Fight know about his musical-theatre credentials? On Broadway, Patinkin originated the roles of both Che in Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Evita and Georges Seurat in Stephen Sondheim’s Sunday in the Park with George . He’s also released several studio albums over the last 30 years, most recently Children and Art in 2019. Ludacris Chris Bridges (a.k.a. Ludacris) with Tyrese Gibson in F9 in 2021. Photo: Everett Collection Ludacris spent the late ’90s and early 2000s becoming a hit on the music charts with songs like “Rollout,” “Stand Up,” “Act a Fool,” and Missy Elliott’s “One Minute Man,” but he also started acting under his given name, Chris Bridges, in the early 2000s for projects like Law & Order: Special Victims Unit (where he played a stepson of Ice-T’s character), 2008’s RocknRolla , and the latter half of the Fast and the Furious series. LL Cool J LL Cool J and Nia Long in In Too Deep in 1999. Photo: Everett Collection After launching his career as a rapper with Def Jam in 1984, LL Cool J (for Ladies Love Cool James) went on to release 13 albums and win two Grammy Awards. He also picked up some acting roles along the way: 1986’s Wildcats , in which he made his film debut alongside Wesley Snipes, Goldie Hawn, and Woody Harrelson, and 1992’s Toys , in which he played against Robin Williams. In 1995, LL Cool J starred in his own television sitcom, In the House ; 1998 brought a role in Halloween H20 and 1999, Deep Blue Sea and Oliver Stone’s smash hit Any Given Sunday . Since 2009, he has starred on the CBS police procedural NCIS: Los Angeles . Queen Latifah Queen Latifah in Chicago in 2002. Photo: Everett Collection Queen Latifah is one of only a handful of hip-hop or R&B artists to receive an Academy Award nomination in an acting category. But before she starred in films like Chicago , Barbershop 2: Back in Business , Beauty Shop , Hairspray , and 2017’s major hit Girls Trip , she was a rapper who released her debut album, All Hail the Queen (featuring the hit single “Ladies First”), with Tommy Boy Records in 1989. Ice Cube Ice Cube with Chris Tucker in Friday in 1995. Photo: Everett Collection As a former member of the Los Angeles-based rap group N.W.A., Ice Cube is counted among the most influential figures in hip-hop history, but his first acting role – as Doughboy in John Singleton’s Boyz n the Hood – is nearly as influential. Ice Cube followed it up with roles in the Friday series (1995, 2000, 2002), the Barbershop series (2002, 2004, 2016), 21 Jump Street (2012), 22 Jump Street (2014), and The High Note (2020). Steve Van Zandt Steve Van Zandt with James Gandolfini and Tony Sirico on The Sopranos in 2006. Photo: Alamy Believe it or not, before he played Silvio Dante on The Sopranos , Steve Van Zandt had had no formal acting experience. A singer, songwriter, guitarist, and mandolin player, he was best known until 1999 as a member of Bruce Springsteen’s E Street Band, with which he’s performed on and off since 1975. Madonna Madonna in A League of Their Own in 1992. Photo: Everett Collection In 1985, less than a year after she released her culture-quaking record Like A Virgin , Madonna also delivered one of her most iconic film roles, starring in Susan Seidelman’s Desperately Seeking Susan alongside Rosanna Arquette. Critical accolades would come later; there were several more musical reinventions to be had before Madonna won the Golden Globe for best actress for Evita in 1997. She also memorably played Mae Mordabito in A League of Their Own (1992), co-starred with Rupert Everett and Benjamin Bratt in a 2000 dramedy called The Next Best Thing , and had a cameo in the 2002 James Bond film Die Another Day . Cher Cher with Olympia Dukakis in Moonstruck in 1987. Photo: Everett Collection A megastar since breaking onto the folk-rock scene as one-half of Sonny & Cher in the mid-1960s, Cher’s first acting role was that same decade (she played a model in the TV series The Man from U.N.C.L.E. ). Not long after, she made her Broadway debut in Robert Altman’s Come Back to the Five and Dime, Jimmy Dean, Jimmy Dean and reprised her role in the 1982 film version, for which she garnered a Golden Globe nomination. She next starred with Meryl Streep and Kurt Russell in the 1983 film Silkwood and won the Best Actress prize at the Cannes Film Festival two years later for her role in Peter Bogdanovich’s 1985 film Mask . She’d go on to star in features like The Witches of Eastwick , Moonstruck , Mermaids , and most recently, 2018’s Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again . Barbra Streisand Barbra Streisand with Nick Nolte in The Prince of Tides in 1991. Photo: Everett Collection For Barbra Streisand, acting was always in the cards; it just so happened that a singing career came first. She was working the New York nightclub scene when the theatre director and playwright Arthur Laurents had her audition for I Can Get It for You Wholesale , the show in which she’d make her Broadway debut (and meet her first husband, Elliott Gould) in 1962. But she’d release three studio albums before becoming Fanny Brice in Funny Girl – and another seven before its film adaptation made her a movie star. Kris Kristofferson Kris Kristofferson with Ellen Burstyn and Alfred Lutter in Alice Doesn’t Live Here Anymore in 1974. Photo: Everett Collection A Rhodes Scholar in his youth, Kris Kristofferson was not only an accomplished athlete when he started making films in the 1970s ( Alice Doesn’t Live Here Anymore with Ellen Burstyn and A Star Is Born with Barbra Streisand among them), but a Grammy- and Country Music Association Award-nominated singer/songwriter, too; penning hit songs for the likes of Janis Joplin, Gladys Knight & The Pips, and Johnny Cash. Frank Sinatra Frank Sinatra (right) with Montgomery Clift in From Here to Eternity in 1953. Photo: Everett Collection He may be best remembered as a recording artist, but Frank Sinatra built up an impressive roster of film roles in the 1950s and 1960s, appearing both in musicals – Anchors Aweigh , On the Town , Guys and Dolls , Pal Joey – and dramas like From Here to Eternity (for which he won the 1954 Oscar for best supporting actor), The Man with the Golden Arm (for which he got a best-actor nod), and Some Came Running . His big mainstream hit was obviously the 1986 fantasy musical Labyrinth , but he also appeared in everything from Tony Scott’s erotic horror film The Hunger to David Lynch’s Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me and many others. Debbie Harry Debbie Harry in Videodrome in 1983. While Debbie Harry ’s most famous turn on the silver screen was probably in David Cronenberg’s enigmatic sci-fi horror Videodrome , she’s actually been in over 30 films. From playing the coiffed antagonist Velma Von Tussle in John Waters’s cult classic Hairspray to a blink-and-you-miss-it role as a bartender in the Robert De Niro-starring Cop Land , the Blondie singer has always been the definition of “multihyphenate”. Britney Spears Britney Spears in Crossroads in 2002. Britney Spears was a natural in Crossroads , the 2002 teen road-trip movie that has since become one of those films that everyone puts on when they feel even slightly down (it’s the ultimate feel-good tonic!). At that point, she’d already released three chart-smashing albums, and would go on to release six more. Aside from a few appearances over the years, she never really continued the acting beat, although she did make a secret voice-over cameo in the 2019 film Corporate Animals as herself. Harry Styles Harry Styles in Dunkirk (2017). Harry Styles in Dunkirk in 2017. One Direction heartthrob Harry Styles made his big-screen debut in Christopher Nolan’s critically lauded (and Academy Award-winning) World War II epic Dunkirk in 2017. But it wasn’t a one-off from the world’s most famous boybander turned megastar. Also among his projects are My Policeman (with The Crown ’s Emma Corrin ) and Olivia Wilde ’s Don’t Worry Darling (with Florence Pugh ). Idris Elba Idris Elba with Caleb McLaughlin in Concrete Cowboy in 2020. Before he was a massively successful star of television and film, Idris Elba was “Big Driis,” a DJ playing across London nightclubs. Yet even as his acting career took off, Elba kept one foot in the music world, releasing his first EP, High Class Problems Vol. 1 , in 2010 ( Luther would debut on the BBC just months later) and doing a two-hour set at Coachella 2019. Will Smith Will Smith in Men in Black in 1997. Will Smith in Men in Black in 1997. Will Smith launched a highly successful – and famously curse-free – rap career with Jeff Townes under the moniker DJ Jazzy Jeff & the Fresh Prince when Smith was still a teenager. In 1986, the pair’s first single, “Girls Ain’t Nothing But Trouble,” was a hit; their 1987 debut album, Rock the House , hit the Billboard Top 200. In 1991, NBC developed a sitcom around Smith, The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air , on which he starred for six seasons before breaking onto the Hollywood A-list with films like 1995’s Bad Boys , 1996’s Independence Day , and 1997’s Men in Black. He went on to earn Oscar nominations for 2001’s Ali and 2006’s The Pursuit of Happyness. Awkwafina Awkwafina in The Farewell in 2019. Awkwafina in The Farewell in 2019. Before she lit up the screen in Ocean’s Eight (2018), Crazy Rich Asians (2018), and The Farewell (2019), Awkwafina (née Nora Lum) made her name as a rapper, going viral on YouTube with the song “My Vag” (yes, really) in 2012 and releasing her debut album, Yellow Ranger , two years later. Jennifer Hudson Jennifer Hudson in Dreamgirls in 2006. Photo: Alamy Two years after she placed seventh on American Idol , Jennifer Hudson won an Oscar for her portrayal of Effie in 2006’s Dreamgirls. She was also handpicked by Aretha Franklin to lead the biopic Respect , released back in 2021. Beyoncé Beyoncé in Austin Powers in Goldmember in 2002. ©New Line Cinema/Courtesy Everett Collection Destiny’s Child was already a big deal by the time Beyoncé starred in her first major motion picture (not counting MTV’s made-for-TV Carmen: A Hip Hopera ), playing a parody of a blaxploitation character in 2002’s Austin Powers in Goldmember. She followed that with 2003’s The Fighting Temptations and The Pink Panther in 2006 before landing one of the starring roles in the Academy Award-winning Dreamgirls from that same year. She later starred in Cadillac Records (2008), Obsessed (2009), and lent her voice to Jon Favreau’s reboot of The Lion King in 2019. Rihanna Rihanna in Ocean’s Eight in 2018. Photo: Barry Wetcher / Courtesy of Warner Brothers / Everett Collection Though Rihanna’s first movie turn was linked to her music career – she appeared in 2006’s Bring It On: All or Nothing (which also had Solange Knowles playing a cheerleader) as herself – she later took on more complex roles, like that of petty officer Cora Raikes in 2012’s Battleship , a “Moon Goddess” in 2014’s Annie , Marion Crane in the Bates Motel television series, a lounge singer in 2017’s Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets , and a hacker named Nine Ball in 2018’s Ocean’s Eight. Most recently, she appeared as Smurfette in Smurfs (2025), which she also produced. Justin Timberlake Justin Timberlake in Alpha Dog in 2006. Photo: Everett Collection Sure, Justin Timberlake began his career on the star-generating children’s television series The Mickey Mouse Club (along with Ryan Gosling, Britney Spears, Christina Aguilera, and Timberlake’s future ’N Sync bandmate JC Chasez), but things didn’t really take off for him as an actor until after his boy band career began to wane. He won two Emmys for his guest spots on Saturday Night Live and starred in films including The Social Network , Bad Teacher , Friends With Benefits , Alpha Dog , and Inside Llewyn Davis , all while maintaining a music career that’s included five studio albums, two compilation albums, and 39 singles (including 18 as a featured artist). Ice-T Ice-T on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit in 2008. Photo: Everett Collection Ice-T began his career as an underground rapper in the 1980s and was signed to Sire Records when he released his debut album Rhyme Pays in 1987. In 1991, he played a police detective in Mario Van Peebles’s film New Jack City ; later that same year, he played a gang leader in Ricochet , acting alongside Denzel Washington and John Lithgow, a performance he followed up with another part as a gang leader in 1992’s Trespass , followed by a lead role in 1994’s Surviving the Game and supporting ones in 1995’s Johnny Mnemonic and Tank Girl. He’s starred as NYPD detective turned sergeant Odafin Tutuola on the NBC police drama Law & Order: Special Victims Unit since 2000. Mandy Moore Mandy Moore in A Walk to Remember in 2002. Photo: Everett Collection In 1999, amidst the craze for pop princesses like Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera, a 15-year-old Mandy Moore delivered the pop album So Real , and it became a hit off its single “ Candy. ” Film roles soon followed, including 2001’s The Princess Diaries and 2002’s A Walk to Remember , which was essentially Love Story for the early aughts with less covetable clothes. Though Moore has since enjoyed major recognition for her turn as Rebecca Pearson on This Is Us , she returned to the studio for the first time in a decade in 2019, releasing her seventh studio album, Silver Landings , in 2020. Mandy Patinkin Mandy Patinkin on Homeland in 2020. Photo: Everett Collection Mandy Patinkin is slightly out of place on this list – a graduate of Juilliard, he has always been an actor who sings – but do the people who love him in The Princess Bride , Criminal Minds , Homeland , and The Good Fight know about his musical-theatre credentials? On Broadway, Patinkin originated the roles of both Che in Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Evita and Georges Seurat in Stephen Sondheim’s Sunday in the Park with George. He’s also released several studio albums over the last 30 years, most recently Children and Art in 2019. Ludacris) with Tyrese Gibson in F9 in 2021. Photo: Everett Collection Ludacris spent the late ’90s and early 2000s becoming a hit on the music charts with songs like “Rollout,” “Stand Up,” “Act a Fool,” and Missy Elliott’s “One Minute Man,” but he also started acting under his given name, Chris Bridges, in the early 2000s for projects like Law & Order: Special Victims Unit (where he played a stepson of Ice-T’s character), 2008’s RocknRolla , and the latter half of the Fast and the Furious series. LL Cool J LL Cool J and Nia Long in In Too Deep in 1999. Photo: Everett Collection After launching his career as a rapper with Def Jam in 1984, LL Cool J (for Ladies Love Cool James) went on to release 13 albums and win two Grammy Awards. He also picked up some acting roles along the way: 1986’s Wildcats , in which he made his film debut alongside Wesley Snipes, Goldie Hawn, and Woody Harrelson, and 1992’s Toys , in which he played against Robin Williams. In 1995, LL Cool J starred in his own television sitcom, In the House ; 1998 brought a role in Halloween H20 and 1999, Deep Blue Sea and Oliver Stone’s smash hit Any Given Sunday. Since 2009, he has starred on the CBS police procedural NCIS: Los Angeles. Queen Latifah Queen Latifah in Chicago in 2002. Photo: Everett Collection Queen Latifah is one of only a handful of hip-hop or R&B artists to receive an Academy Award nomination in an acting category. But before she starred in films like Chicago , Barbershop 2: Back in Business , Beauty Shop , Hairspray , and 2017’s major hit Girls Trip , she was a rapper who released her debut album, All Hail the Queen (featuring the hit single “Ladies First”), with Tommy Boy Records in 1989. Ice Cube Ice Cube with Chris Tucker in Friday in 1995. Photo: Everett Collection As a former member of the Los Angeles-based rap group N. , Ice Cube is counted among the most influential figures in hip-hop history, but his first acting role – as Doughboy in John Singleton’s Boyz n the Hood – is nearly as influential. Ice Cube followed it up with roles in the Friday series (1995, 2000, 2002), the Barbershop series (2002, 2004, 2016), 21 Jump Street (2012), 22 Jump Street (2014), and The High Note (2020). Steve Van Zandt Steve Van Zandt with James Gandolfini and Tony Sirico on The Sopranos in 2006. Photo: Alamy Believe it or not, before he played Silvio Dante on The Sopranos , Steve Van Zandt had had no formal acting experience. A singer, songwriter, guitarist, and mandolin player, he was best known until 1999 as a member of Bruce Springsteen’s E Street Band, with which he’s performed on and off since 1975. Madonna Madonna in A League of Their Own in 1992. Photo: Everett Collection In 1985, less than a year after she released her culture-quaking record Like A Virgin , Madonna also delivered one of her most iconic film roles, starring in Susan Seidelman’s Desperately Seeking Susan alongside Rosanna Arquette. Critical accolades would come later; there were several more musical reinventions to be had before Madonna won the Golden Globe for best actress for Evita in 1997. She also memorably played Mae Mordabito in A League of Their Own (1992), co-starred with Rupert Everett and Benjamin Bratt in a 2000 dramedy called The Next Best Thing , and had a cameo in the 2002 James Bond film Die Another Day. Cher Cher with Olympia Dukakis in Moonstruck in 1987. Photo: Everett Collection A megastar since breaking onto the folk-rock scene as one-half of Sonny & Cher in the mid-1960s, Cher’s first acting role was that same decade (she played a model in the TV series The Man from U. Not long after, she made her Broadway debut in Robert Altman’s Come Back to the Five and Dime, Jimmy Dean, Jimmy Dean and reprised her role in the 1982 film version, for which she garnered a Golden Globe nomination. She next starred with Meryl Streep and Kurt Russell in the 1983 film Silkwood and won the Best Actress prize at the Cannes Film Festival two years later for her role in Peter Bogdanovich’s 1985 film Mask. She’d go on to star in features like The Witches of Eastwick , Moonstruck , Mermaids , and most recently, 2018’s Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again. Barbra Streisand Barbra Streisand with Nick Nolte in The Prince of Tides in 1991. Photo: Everett Collection For Barbra Streisand, acting was always in the cards; it just so happened that a singing career came first. She was working the New York nightclub scene when the theatre director and playwright Arthur Laurents had her audition for I Can Get It for You Wholesale , the show in which she’d make her Broadway debut (and meet her first husband, Elliott Gould) in 1962. But she’d release three studio albums before becoming Fanny Brice in Funny Girl – and another seven before its film adaptation made her a movie star. By Andy Kahn Oct 28, 2025 • 2:08 pm PDT Share This Dawes will host A Concert For Altadena on January 7 at Pasadena Civic Center in Pasadena, California, with proceeds going toward wildfire recovery efforts through the Altadena Builds Back Foundation . The all-star concert will feature performances by Stephen Stills , Jackson Browne , Jenny Lewis and others. The benefit show coincides with the one year anniversary of the Eaton Fire that devastated the town of Altadena, California. Dawes co-founders – brothers Taylor Goldsmith and Griffin Goldsmith – were among the thousands impacted by the devastating Los Angeles wildfires. The Eaton fire destroyed Taylor’s home studio and damaged the home he shares with his wife Mandy Moore . Griffin lost his entire home and recording studio storing an array of instruments. “A Concert For Altadena – January 7th marks a year to the day that our sweet town got ravaged by the Eaton Fire,” Dawes shared . “We’re organizing a night of music to support the Altadena Builds Back Foundation (part of the Pasadena Community Foundation) — helping rally and rebuild the community that’s given us so much. It’s gonna be a heavy night but it’s going to be a beautiful one too.” A Concert For Altadena will also include performances by Brandon Flowers of The Killers , Brad Paisley , Aloe Blacc , Eric Krasno , Judith Hill , Everclear , Ozomatli and Mandy Moore. Additional artists are expected to be announced. A Concert For Altadena tickets go on sale on Friday, November 7.
