With a limited number of episodes to convey their story, these shows often attempt to fit maximum creativity and brilliance into each installment, and that approach has led to some of the most celebrated productions of all time. Sure, not every miniseries is automatically a masterpiece, but the truly great ones are all the more enjoyable because of their contained narratives. Several great miniseries have graced our screens over the years, especially in the past decade, but only a handful have achieved true perfection. With flawless narratives, performances, and productions, these shows easily rank among the best of all time and are more than worth watching for any fan of great television. Read on to discover our handpicked selection of flawless miniseries where every episode is absolutely perfect, including some of the most acclaimed shows of recent years. 8 ‘Ripley’ (2024) Andrew Scott as Tom Ripley leaning on a chair in Episode 5 of Netflix's Ripley. Image via Netflix Created, written, and directed by Steven Zaillian , Ripley is a period psychological thriller miniseries adapted from Patricia Highsmith ’s Tom Ripley novels. Starring Andrew Scott as the title character, New York City con man Tom Ripley, the show explores his descent into darkness after he is hired to go to Italy and convince the prodigal son of a shipping magnate to return to America. The series also boasts an ensemble supporting cast that includes Dakota Fanning , Johnny Flynn , Eliot Sumner , and more. Released on Netflix in April 2024 to critical and audience acclaim, Ripley was a popular and highly recommended title at the time of its premiere, debuting at number six on Netflix's list of top 10 English TV shows. Presented in beautiful black and white, the series is an undeniable masterpiece, boasting supremely polished writing, direction, cinematography, and performances. A visually stunning drama that draws inspiration from classic Italian cinema and Renaissance art, the show earned several accolades, including four Emmy Awards out of thirteen nominations, three Golden Globe nominations, and a Peabody Award. 7 ‘The Fall of the House of Usher’ (2023) Carla Gugino as the Red Death in Netflix’s The Fall of the House of Usher Image via Netflix Created by Mike Flanagan , The Fall of the House of Usher is a Gothic horror drama miniseries inspired by the works of Edgar Allan Poe , primarily his 1840 short story. The series revolves around pharma billionaire siblings Roderick ( Bruce Greenwood ) and Madeline Usher ( Mary McDonnell ), exploring their rise to wealth and power in the 1950s and the eerie present-day events that lead to their family’s inevitable doom. The ensemble cast also includes Carla Gugino , Henry Thomas , Kate Siegel , Rahul Kohli , Samantha Sloyan , T'Nia Miller , Zach Gilford , Willa Fitzgerald , Mark Hamill , and more. The Fall of the House of Usher was quite well-received by critics at the time of its premiere, and even more so by audiences. A haunting Gothic series that looks at the classic themes of greed and moral decay through a contemporary and timely lens, the show is a gorgeously produced masterpiece with amazing performances and visual design that draw viewers into its chilling world. Arguably one of Flanagan’s best shows yet, the series perfectly balances moving character drama with stomach-turning horror, brilliantly adapting some of Poe’s most iconic works, including popular favorites like “The Raven," "The Tell-Tale Heart," and “The Masque of the Red Death. " 6 ‘Watchmen’ (2019) Regina King as Angela in Watchmen Image via HBO Inspired by the eponymous 1986 DC Comics series by Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons , Watchmen is a superhero mystery drama series developed by Damon Lindelof that serves as a sequel to the legendary graphic novel series. Set 34 years after the original story, the show follows a series of escalating events in Tulsa, Oklahoma, involving costumed police officers, a mysterious corporation, and a white supremacist group inspired by the vigilante Rorschach. While investigating these troubling incidents, Detective Angela Abar ( Regina King ) uncovers a decades-spanning conspiracy centered on the all-powerful superhuman, Doctor Manhattan. Don Johnson , Tim Blake Nelson , Yahya Abdul-Mateen II , Andrew Howard , Louis Gossett Jr. , Jeremy Irons , Jean Smart , Hong Chau , and more star in key supporting roles. A brilliant reimagining of the iconic comics that’s both original and faithful to the source material, Watchmen is a masterfully crafted series that’s essentially a sci-fi conspiracy thriller dressed in the tropes of the superhero genre. The show was universally acclaimed during its original run and has been widely hailed as the greatest superhero show of all time. Its complex writing, gorgeous visuals, and mindblowing performances earned the series a massive number of accolades, including 11 Emmy Awards. 5 ‘Adolescence’ (2025) Owen Cooper in Adolescence Image via Netflix A British crime drama miniseries created by Jack Thorne and Stephen Graham , Adolescence follows the story of 13-year-old Jamie Miller ( Owen Cooper ), who is arrested for the murder of a girl at his school. As the story unfolds, we learn more about how the child’s actions may have been influenced by severe cyberbullying and exposure to online misogyny. Graham also stars in the series, playing Jamie’s father, Eddie. The ensemble cast includes Ashley Walters , Erin Doherty , Faye Marsay , Christine Tremarco , and more. Easily one of the biggest hits of 2025, Adolescence is a gripping crime series that has earned near-universal acclaim for its direction, writing, cinematography, and performances, especially that of its young star. Its powerful, timely story is brought to life in four haunting episodes, each filmed in a single long take. A perfect show without a single weak moment, the series has sparked important conversations about how social media exposes children to unprecedented levels of harmful content and garnered several accolades, including acting Emmy wins for Graham, Cooper, and Doherty. 4 ‘WandaVision’ (2021) Wanda (Elizabeth Olsen) parodying 'Modern Family's home interviews in 'WandaVision' Episode 7. Image via Disney+ A Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) miniseries inspired by the Marvel Comics characters Vision and Scarlet Witch, WandaVision was created by Jac Schaeffer and stars Elizabeth Olsen as Wanda Maximoff / The Scarlet Witch and Paul Bettany as Vision. Set shortly after the events of Avengers: Endgame , the show begins with Wanda and Vision enjoying an idyllic, sitcom-like life in the suburb of Westview, New Jersey, but as time passes, darker secrets come to light about the nature of their new reality. Besides Olsen and Bettany, the series also stars Debra Jo Rupp , Fred Melamed , Kathryn Hahn , Teyonah Parris , Randall Park , Kat Dennings , and Evan Peters. A genre-bending miniseries that follows a complex mystery story while paying tribute to the history of sitcoms, WandaVision is arguably Marvel’s best show to date. A favorite of critics and audiences alike, the show has been praised for its breathtaking visuals, powerful themes, and great acting. Each episode pays tribute to an iconic era of sitcoms, but underneath that seemingly comedic exterior is a dark, emotionally charged story of magic, mystery, and love. 3 ‘Chernobyl’ (2019) Jared Harris as Valery Legasov leaning against a wall in Chernobyl (2019). Image via HBO A historical drama miniseries created by Craig Mazin and directed by Johan Renck , Chernobyl is a dramatized exploration of true events surrounding the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear disaster. Over the course of five episodes, the show recounts the events that led to the disaster, the efforts of first responders who worked to clean up the aftermath, and the sinister cover-up that followed. The series stars an ensemble cast that includes Jared Harris , Stellan Skarsgård , Emily Watson , Paul Ritter , and more. Chernobyl was easily one of the biggest international successes of 2019, closely followed by audiences around the world during its initial run and widely acclaimed by critics. Though fictionalized, the series is largely true to history, a fact that makes it all the more immersive and suspenseful. Praised for its atmosphere, writing, cinematography, music, and performances, the show earned several accolades, including 10 Emmy Awards out of 19 nominations and nine BAFTAs out of 14 nominations. 2 ‘When They See Us’ (2019) Caleel Harris as Antron McCray in When They See Us Image via Netflix Based on the real-life 1989 Central Park jogger case, When They See Us is a crime drama miniseries created, co-written, and directed by Ava DuVernay. The series explores the lives of the five Black and Latino suspects who were falsely accused of rape and assault, leading to decades of imprisonment for a crime they didn’t commit. The show’s ensemble cast includes Jharrel Jerome , Asante Blackk , Caleel Harris , Jovan Adepo , Michael K. Williams , Logan Marshall-Green , Joshua Jackson , Blair Underwood , Vera Farmiga , and more. Released in May 2019, When They See Us was a critical and commercial success, reportedly streamed by over 23 million viewers within its first month. A moving story of systemic injustice and a decades-long fight to right wrongs, the series has been praised for its performances, writing, and direction. A heartbreaking true story , the show received numerous accolades, including 11 Emmy nominations and a Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Limited Series. A companion special hosted by Oprah Winfrey was released in June 2019 that features interviews with the creator, cast, and the real Exonerated Five. 1 ‘Dracula’ (2020) Claes Bang holding a cloth up to his mouth in 'Dracula. ' Image via the BBC A three-part horror drama inspired by Bram Stoker ’s classic 1897 novel, Dracula was developed by Mark Gatiss and Steven Moffat and stars Claes Bang as the iconic vampire. Beginning with the familiar story of Jonathan Harker’s ( John Heffernan ) doomed visit to Transylvania, the series explores Dracula’s blood-soaked history, the secret depths of his psyche, and his generations-spanning conflict with the Van Helsing family. Dolly Wells , Morfydd Clark , Joanna Scanlan , Jonathan Aris , Sacha Dhawan , Catherine Schell , Lydia West , and more star in supporting roles. Dracula first aired on BBC One in the UK over three consecutive days, winning favorable reviews from critics and audiences ahead of its Netflix release. An underrated masterpiece, the series is easily one of the most insightful adaptations of the classic Gothic novel, with an entertaining balance of horror and humor that helps bring new life to the source material. Though it hasn’t quite received the attention it deserves, the show is practically perfect in every way, from its story and performances to its art design and cinematography. It’s a deliciously thrilling watch for fans of the vampire genre. text: Join 411’s Live AEW Dynamite Coverage | 411MANIA | Wrestling News, WWE & AEW Results Wrestling News Columns TV reports Video Reviews The Dunn List Csonka Reviews Hall of Fame News TV Reports Movies / tv News Reviews Columns Mma News Reports Columns Contact About wrestling / News Join 411’s Live AEW Dynamite Coverage November 12, 2025 | Posted by Ryan Ciocco Image Credit: AEW Share on twitter Share on facebook Tweet Keep Refreshing For The Latest Results SICKOS! It’s Wednesday, you know what that means! AEW Dynamite is LIVE tonight from Greensboro, North Carolina! And tonight is no ordinary episode of Dynamite, no sir, because tonight, it is all about three words, two rings, and one cage… BLOOD AND GUTS! For the unacquainted, the Blood and Guts setup is somewhat similar to the “what’s old is new again” concept of War Games. Think of WAR GAMES being said in William Bloody Regal’s voice, and it’s set to make it more epic. Now, apply that to BLOOD AND GUTS. Epic, no? This year, not only will be getting the usual Men’s B&G match, but we will also be getting a Women’s B&G match as well! In addition to that, the Women’s match plans to be more chaotic and have more moving parts than the men’s match based on the fact that there will be six women on both teams, as opposed to five on both Men’s teams. As for who is involved, well, in the men’s match, we have the unified front of the Death Riders taking on The Conglomeration, Roderick Strong, and Darby Allin. Given that everyone (most especially the Conglomeration and the armaments aligned with them) is opposed to the Death Riders, this match makes a lot of sense and doesn’t feel thrown together just to have a B&G match. As for the Women’s match, on one side, we will have the Triangle of Madness, Marina Shafir, Megan Bayne, and the holder of every women’s title in the known galaxy save Kris’ title, Mercedes Mone. Standing in opposition of them, we have Jamie Hayter, Willow Nightingale, Harley Cameron, TIMELESS Toni Storm, my future Ex-Wife Mina Shirakawa, and the AEW World Women’s Champion Kris Statlander. Aside from Blood and Guts matches, we will have a Falls Count Anywhere match, pitting the AEW Men’s World Champion Hangman Adam Page against Powerhouse Hobbs. And, although that is all we have seen announced so far officially, I am sure that we will have more in store for us tonight. After all, I have it on good authority that tonight’s show is listed for two and a half hours which, you know, makes sense given the amount of time B&G matches usually get. Plus, clean up and all that fun stuff. Anyway, how are you fine people tonight? I just watched the third episode of IT: Welcome to Derry because I forgot I had it saved to my list on HBO Max. I’ve also gotten into DMV and Shifting Gears, one because it’s hilarious, and the other because it features Kat Dennings. So, enough about all of that, let’s get ready to make the Dynamite go BOOM and witness some blood (and perhaps, yes, guts)! Image Credit: Follow the Revolution – FTR on Facebook. IYKYK Tonight, Blood and Guts Dynamite is LIVE from Greensboro, North Carolina! Excalibur, Tony Schiavone, and Bryan Danielson are on the call tonight! YOU WANTED WAR! How appropriate tonight lol. The arena has went dark. Justin Roberts says this is the first ever Women’s Blood and Guts! These women continue to make history, kick ass, and I (and you) love it! He runs down the rules for the match. You know the drill, the match doesn’t start until everyone is in the ring. You cannot escape, you have to be submit or surrender. No pin falls will help. Women’s Blood & Guts Match: The Triangle of Madness, Marina Shafir, Megan Bayne, and Mercedes Mone vs. Jamie Hayter, Willow Nightingale, Harley Cameron, TIMELESS Toni Storm, Mina Shirakawa, and Kris Statlander Skye Blue and Willow Nightingale are starting us off. Both ladies get ready for WAR! Blue and Nightingale, harnessing weapons, attack one another and keep canceling each other out. Willow switches levels and hammers away on Skye. She takes her to the other ring, rams her head into the corner, and then swings her around by her hair. The guys make jokes about being married and women having their hair up, as Skye tries to run Willow’s face into the cage. She fights it off, Skye fights it off, but Willow overpowers her and slams her face first into the cage. Willow suplexes Blue on the top rope and hits a drive by kick. Doctor Bomb by Willow, as Skye hits the cage face first. POUNCE, PERIOD, and Willow is in complete control early. Blue is fulfilling the BLOOD part of the namesake, as Willow elbows her in the head. She takes her back to ring one and clotheslines her repeatedly in the corner. Short arm clothesline from Willow. Willow sits Skye on the top rope and goes up top. Skye shows some life and tries to strike Willow. Both ladies jockey for position. Julia Hart is out next to help her fellow TOM partner. Hart trips up Willow in the corner, and the Sisters of Sin hit a double powerbomb out of the corner. Hart rips the pad off of the top piece of iron behind the turnbuckle and bashes her head into the corner. Hart with the Undertaker rope walk to follow. Hart checks on Blue, who is bleeding out of control, as they check for something in the corner. They instead got to ring two and proceed to double team Willow. Cartwheel clothesline from Blue, and a running back elbow from Hart. They do the double team front suplex and basement SUPERKICKS. FEEL THE WRATH , as Harley Cameron is here with chair in tow. She chucks it at Blue, and hits a sling blade on Hart. She pounds away on her and shouts FEEL THE WRATH! She hits corner clotheslines to both SOS, but Skye stops her. They try a double team suplex, but Willow helps out and they both suplex Hart and Blue. Hart is set in the Tree of WHOA and Harley hits a dropkick to her. They put a trash can lid on Skye’s midsection, and Willow with the CANNONABLL! PIP Break. (Again, I say, BOO to breaks during Women’s matches, even if it is bloody and gutsy!) Skye has a choke on Harley, while Willow hits the POUNCE, PERIOD to Hart as we return from break. Thekla is out next. Call me crazy (I know I am, but what are YOU), but I feel like this kind of match is best fit for her. As if on cue, she enters with a crossbody to Willow and a SPEAR to Willow. Thekla takes off her belt and she whips both Willow and Harley with it. Blue and Thekla hit stereo running boots to Harley and Willow. Jamie Hayter is here to even the odds for her team. She smacks Skye with a bag of tacks! She beats all the TOM members with a kendo stick! Blue stops her momentum, but Hayter gets the last laugh as she hits a double suplex on Hart and Blue. Thekla with a rolling elbow, but Jamie drops Thekla face first into the tacks. Jamie beats all her opponents with the belt that Thekla took off. Megan Bayne is here, along with Penelope Ford , who is holding a chair. Running knee strike to Hayter. Lariat to Willow. Fallaway Slam on Cameron. Bayne stacks of Harley and Willow and hits a running splash. She brings both ladies to the middle of the ring and hits a suplex as the fans approve. Hayter is back, as she trades strikes with Bayne. Megan picks her up and drops her to the mat. German suplex from Megan follows. Bless Harley, she smacks Megan in the back and it had no effect. So, she tries again, only for Bayne to cut her off, and she suplexes Harley on top of the garbage lid. The AEW Women’s World Champion is here, as Statlander hits the ring with a pool cue. She goes to top while still wearing her title belt and smashes it over the back of Bayne. She hits the corner and hits a double back elbow to Hart and Blue. She chucks Thekla into the cage and hits a lariat to Bayne. Queen Aminata chases Ford away from ring side. Willow and Kris come face-to-face. They seem like they want to shake hands, but Bayne interrupts that. Kris and Megan come to blows, and female MEAT is going to be dealt. I think? Sure, why not. PIP Break incoming. (Again, FACK THE BREAKS IN A WOMENS MATCH!) Harley is climbing the cage as Megan tries to catch her as we return. Harley with a crossbody from the top, taking our three of her opponents. C-E-O Ultimo Mone is here. I’m so glad she is dressed for the occasion lol. Mone finally gets into the ring after having some champaign. She hits a head scissors to Harley, but Kris snatches her up and sits her in the corner. Statlander looking for Staturday Night Fever onto her title belt, but Mone sneaks out the back and hits a front Russian Leg Sweep on Kris. Mone has left the ring, as she is putting all of her title belts in the ring. Well, shit, we’re not going to have room for ANYONE or ANYTHING else with all of that gold in there. She hands the title belts out to her teammates like they are participation trophies lol. The bad girls proceed to whip the good girls with said title belts. The love of my life and future Ex-Wife Mina Shirakawa is here next! She has herself a baseball bat, as she gently hits Thekla in the ass with it. She throws it to Bayne, and she dropkicks her. She grabs Mone’s hand, goes to the top, and hits an arm drag. Hart and Mone try to double team her, but Mina kicks Hart away and snaps off a Rana on Mone. Mone takes Mina to the corner and pounds away on her. YOU GOT 99 ANSWERS BUT THERE’S ONLY ONE PROBLEM ! Marina Shafir is here as the sixth and final member of her team. Shafir enters the cage and goes right after Statlander. She drags Kris out of the cage and onto the floor. Shafir whips Kris into the barricade and goes under the side of the barricade. She drags out a bed of nails! Kris jumps on her back, but Marina fights her off and throws her on top of the nails. FLAWLESS…VICTORY ! Marina removes her boots and socks as she re-enters the ring. TIMELESS and even crazier Toni Storm is here as the last member of her team, as the bell rings, and the cage is locked! She has a fistful of pearls! She smacks Bayne, Hart, and Thekla with them. She smacks Marina, but Shafir doesn’t feel it. Everyone squares off with an opponent and, remember, this can only end with submission or surrender. Storm has a bucket, she has broken glass on her hands! She jabs Marina with it! Double hip attack by the Love Bombs to Marina and then Megan! Mina and Toni hit a double team DDT to Megan as we head for ANOTHER PIP Break. (Again, this thing about commercials during a women’s match!) Hayter and Blue have climbed the cage, and Hayter hammers her head into the cage as we return. She puts Blue onto a table that is set up, and she splashes her through the table! Willow with (kind of a) POUNCE, PERIOD on Thekla and Hart. Mina with a tornado DDT to Bayne. Marina clobbers her with one of the titles from the Mone collection. Mone hits the Bank Statement on Mina. Harley has Puppet Mone! Mone takes it away, but Harley has brass knuckles! She punches Mone in the chest. Hart attacks her from behind, as Hart and Thekla climb out of the cage and to the floor. Hart demands that Mike Posey give them the key, and Thekla with a SPEAR to Posey! Hart opens the cage, as the bad girls proceed to throw their opponents out and to the floor. Thekla with a double SPEAR to Harley and Willow on the floor. The cage door gets slammed into the head of Bayne. Mone and Statlander climb the truss at cage side. SAMOAN DROP BY STATLANDER, DRIVING MONE AND HERSELF THROUGH THE TABLE AND BELTS AT RING SIDE! Hart and Thekla re-enter the ring and lock the cage again, leaving every woman who left the ring outside the ring. Storm spreads the rest of the broken glass from the champaign. DOUBLE DDT BY MINA AND TONI TO MARINA! Storm sets a mirror in front of Marina, she looks for the rear view. MARINA THROWS THE MIRROR INTO THE HEAD OF TONI! HOLY SHIT! Willow with a suplex to Megan! MINA IS LOOKING CRAZY! SHE WRAPS THE BARBWIRE BAT AROUND THE KNEE OF BAYNE AND APPLIES THE FIGURE FOUR! Marina stomps on the broken glass and stomps on the ample chest of Mina. The TOM restrain Storm, as Marina has Mina in a choke, as Megan whips Mina with a title belt. Toni Storm surrenders the match! WINNER: The Triangle of Madness, Megan Bayne, Marina Shafir, and Mercedes Mone TIME: 46:00 THOUGHTS: Usually viewed as a men’s kind of match, the women said, “Hold our collective beers”, and went out and did more insane shit than the men could ever think/dream of. Crazy spots, some creativeness, and a lot of blood and weapons. Also, the ending plays in to not just the upcoming Bayne/Shafir and Mina/Toni match, but Toni giving up the match for her team to try and save Mina plays into their love angle. A great match and a gusty (no pun intended) by the women. RATING: ****1/4 Post-match, the heels continue the beatdown of Mina, as Toni tries to cover her up and protect her. Aubrey Edwards admonishes Marina and, surprisingly, Shafir did NOT knock her out again. The heels celebrate heading up the ramp, as Mina gets helped to her feet. Video package for the Hobbs and Page match later tonight. COMMERCIALS! We see a brawl between members of the Don Callis Family and the Jurassic Express . After they are subdued, The Young Bucks, Kazuchika Okada, and Don Callis emerge from their trailer. Alexander says this is what happens when you cross their family. Okada taps the “watch” on his wrist and tells the Bucks its decision time! Drum beat… The Champ is Here ! Drum Beat…repeat! Falls Count Anywhere Match: Hangman Adam Page vs. Powerhouse Hobbs Hobbs rips a turnbuckle pad off in ring two as the bell rings. Not content to be outdone, Page also rips one off out of spite. Both men slug it out. Hobbs pick up Page, he goes to throw him into one of the exposed corners, but he escapes, and they struggle for control. Page catches Hobbs with a boot and a low bridge. Hangman with his corner lariat from ring two to ring one. Page hits another corner lariat. He leaps over Hobbs on the third attempt, and Hobbs hits a big lariat. Page rolls out of the ring and to the floor, as Hobbs ripped the wrap off the midsection of the champion. He rams Page into the barricade as a girl chants HOLY SHIT! He does it again into the apron and throws Page into the ring. Hobbs turns around to look into the crowd, but Page with a tope to the back of Hobbs! Page with some offense, but one knee to the midsection cancels that out. Hobbs runs Page face first into the ring post and then slams him into the barricade. Hobbs moves the ring steps and sets Page against them. Hobbs charges in, but Page moves, and Hobbs goes PLOP. Hangman jumps off the steps and into the arms of Hobbs like a fair catch on a punt. He slams Page into the ring apron and into the announcer’s table. Hobbs tells Schiavone this is all his fault, as he walks up the steps with Page. HOBBS WITH THE WORLD’S DANGEROUS SLAM ONTO THE RING STEPS! Hobbs goes back to talk more mad shit to Tony as we hit PIP Break. Hobbs with an Oklahoma Stampede to Page for a two count as we return from break. Hobbs sends Page from the ring, says I TOLD YOU, then walks over the announcer’s table. He removes the top and climbs on top of it with Page. Hobbs takes WAY too long, and Page back drops Hobbs off the table and to the floor. Page tries to psyche himself up, as he runs and clotheslines Hobbs into the crowd! They fight up the steps, as Page hits ten punches. He grabs a beer from a willing fan and hits the Orihara moonsault from atop the balcony! Page with a lariat, but Hobbs is still on his feet. Page looking for Deadeye, but Hobbs sneaks out the back door. Page hits him with a trash can, but he charges into Hobbs, and he hits a spinebuster through a table! Hobbs pulls his straps down , and he drags Page up the step. Hobbs thinking World’s Most Dangerous Slam, but Page escapes that. Hobbs is hanging precariously over the rail. Hangman takes his boot off. HE CHARGES FORWARD AND HITS HOBBS WITH IT, AS HOBBS CRASHES DOWN INTO THE EQUIPMENT BOX! The lights flicker on and off as a result of this, as Page goes down to ground level. He pins Hobbs to win the match. WINNER: Hangman Adam Page TIME: 14:10 THOUGHTS: Funny to think that a match like this could be considered a “cool down” match after the chaos that unfolded with the Women’s B&G war, but that kind of felt like it. And it’s not the fault of the men in this match, per se, they had a tough guy brawl all around the arena. Hangman won, as he should, and he got his ass kicked, like Hobbs would do. RATING: ***1/2 Post-match, Katsuyori Shibata arrives to attack Page! Joe is here as well with a chair, as they beat up Page. Joe looks at the cage, and it starts to lower. Before it can, Eddie Kingston arrives to do battle with Shibata! HOOK is here! Eddie and HOOK get into the ring, as Shibata and Joe escape and the cage sets. Page gets a mic. Samoa Joe, if you wanted me in a steel cage, all you had to do was ask, you dumbass. So, at Full Gear, leave Shibata at home, and leave Hobbs in the hospital, because it will be you and me inside a steel cage for my title! Joe is beside himself at this announcement for some reason or another. The main event, the Men’s B&G match, is up next! COMMERCIALS! Excalibur shills Draft Kings as we return. He says that TK has made the match official for Full Gear. It will be Joe and Page inside a SALAD STEEL CAGE! Schiavone is in the ring. He waxed poetic about the history of wrestling in Charlotte, and how much it means to him to be here to celebrate this occasion. He introduces Ricky The Dragon Steamboat ! The Dragon has arrived! He gets into the ring and embraces Tony. Tony was here in June 1978 as a fan when Ricky and Paul Jones teamed up to become world tag team champions. Ricky and Dusty Rhodes became tag team champions on TBS! Ricky wants to thank TBS for airing this. He points out a poster that shows the Mount Rushmore of Wrestling. It’s Flair, Dusty, Sting, and Steamboat! Ricky says his #1 nemesis was Sting. He came to Mid-Atlantic Wrestling when he was 16 months into the business. Ric Flair went to Jim Crockett and said they have a real good kid here. Let’s see what we can do with him. But FTR and their awesome music are here! Ricky says he knows him, but which him is the question. Ricky says he knows Dax. He wants to mention that a few years back he had his hand in working with him. He saw in the back that he is climbing that ladder and he is making it up. Stoke says thank you. He says he can’t believe he is standing in the ring with a legend. Now, Ricky, you know FTR are the greatest tag team alive today. But Ricky, my name is Big Stoke, and no, he is not Denzel Washington, apparently people get them confused lol. Ricky is synonymous with professional wrestling history, especially in this building. But it’s ironic, because next Saturday, the 22nd, in Newark New Jersey, FTR will make history when they become 3-time tag team champions. Stoke asks Ricky for Macho Man’s phone number, he hasn’t sent him a TikTok in a while. LOL! Cash Wheeler takes the mic. He shows a picture of Ricky’s last match with FTR. He says Ricky picked them because he knows they are miracle workers and they could drag this former shell of a man to a good match. Dax says Ricky took him under his wing 13 years ago. He taught him, um, hold on, he’s got this. Oh wait, Ricky hasn’t said one intelligent thing in his life. Ricky says one thing he didn’t teach him is that his attitude has gone into the toilet. Dax says you told him that it doesn’t matter how much you make, it’s how you manage it. And if you had taken your own advice, you and Ric Flair wouldn’t be here. Back in 2012, who would have thought they would be standing in a ring on TBS. And who knew that Dax would be an even bigger legend than you are. Ricky and Dax come face-to-face. Cash approaches to intimidate him. Dax tells Ricky to leave his ring. Dax picks up the mic and tells him to get out of his ring. Ricky take the mic from Tony. Going back a few years ago, I would tell both of you to kiss my ass. But, sometimes, discretion is the better part of valor. He realizes he is going to be 73. He isn’t begging or asking for any kind of sorrow or forgiveness, so he is going to be the bigger man today. Dax says give it up for Ricky Steamboat. FTR ambush him! They’re setting up for the stuff piledriver, but Brodido are here to make the save! 21-Plex to Wheeler, as King takes him out of the ring. RICKY LANDS SOME RIGHTS TO DAX! King has Dax up, but Stoke pulls him to safety. Bandido kicks Wheeler back out of the ring, and Stoke has a shoe in his hand lol. Brody and Bandido shake hands with Ricky as FTR and Stoke take their leave. Hey, guys and girls, remember twenty minutes ago when they said the Men’s B&G main event was next? Well, that’s FRFR this time! COMMERCIALS! Men’s Blood & Guts Match: Darby Allin, Roderick Strong, and the Conglomeration vs. The Death Riders The Darbster is out first for his team, while Sheepdog Yuta is out first for the Death Riders. The bell rings, as Yuta walks back out of the cage, because he’s a sheepish coward lol. He talks trash with the fans, but Allin sneaks up behind him and hits a missile dropkick. Allin throws Yuta from barricade back to the cage. He sends him into the barricade. He charges in, but Yuta moves, and Darby goes splat. FUCK YOU YUTA chants again, as Yuta mocks Darby to get back into the ring. Yuta waits for Allin to get to the door, and he kicks it into the head of Darby. He continues to talk that mad smack, as he grabs Allin and brings him back in. Yuta tells the ref to close this shit, because Allin keeps running. Right, lol. Yuta continues to taunt Darby, so Allin springs off the top rope, off the cage, and hits a Coffin Drop! Yuta goes for Darby’s skateboard, but Allin hits a destroyer. We see the tacks on the bottom of Darby’s skateboard, and Allin grinds it into the forehead of Yuta. YOU DESERVE IT chants, and Danielson agrees lol. Yuta with a low blow, as Allin hits the mat in pain. Orange Death Cassidy is here with his backpack and his elbow pad in his back pocket. FRESHLY SQUEEZED chants as Cassidy breaks his own sunglasses. He uses the broken part to gouge at the forehead of Yuta! Allin and Cassidy take turns hitting back splashes to Yuta, as Cassidy lands some deadly punches to the gut of Yuta. Allin grabs his skateboard, ascends to the top, and comes down on Yuta with his skateboard. Yuta scrams like a spoiled brat lol. No Dances Danny is out next to even things up. He wears a surgical mask to the ring, and Tony laments that it won’t help Danny in this. I mean… Garcia enters the cage and attacks both Cassidy and Yuta. He has both of them in a choke as Yuta attacks from behind. Yuta has a chain in hand, they chop Cassidy to the ropes, and then hits a double team lariat with the chain to the throat of Cassidy. Yuta stomps on Allin as we head to PIP Break. Allin and Cassidy wrap up Yuta and Garcia in the chain that Yuta brought into the ring, as the Man Who Diversifies his Portfolio is out next. Or not? Apparently, something has happened in the back. Renee is seen walking the back, as Roddy and Kyle go into a locker room to find Briscoe hunched over on the floor. Kyle ask what they are going to do? Roddy says he’ll go out now. So, make that the Messiah of the Backbreaker coming out now. He hits both Yuta and Garcia with a backbreaker and a cutter to Yuta. The Swiss Cyborg is out next to even the odds at three. Strong attacks Claudio, but he shoves him off and throws him into the chair lodged in the corner of the ring. Claudio goes for the Giant Swing on Allin, but Cassidy jumps on his back. Claudio still swings Darby with Cassidy on his back, as Yuta puts up his hands and says I’m good lol. Claudio throws Allin from ring to ring and grinds the face of Roddy into the cage. Garcia with the surfboard on Allin, launching him right into an uppercut from Claudio. The one True Kyle is out next for his team. Double leg takedown to Yuta as he pounds away on him. KOR catches Garcia with a side suplex. Claudio catches KOR with an uppercut, but Kyle catches him with a running knee. Front face look into a Guillotine by KOR. Claudio powers out of it, but KOR with a chop block. Strong and O’Reilly with a tandem jumping knee strikes. Yuta hits All in the gut with a chair, while Garcia chokes out Strong in the ropes. Claudio and O’Reilly trade blows in ring two, while everyone else battles in ring one. Yuta with a suplex to Strong onto a chair, while Garcia sends Cassidy out of the ring, trapping Cassidy between the ring and the cage. Piledriver by Yuta to Allin as we hit break. The Death Riders are running train over their opponents as we return from break. Claudio chucks Cassidy into the ring, as Jonny John Jon is out next. Kind of interesting that Jon would come out before PAC, but here we are. Moxley attacks O’Reilly’s head with a fork. He punches away on Strong before forking him in the head. Or eye, says Excalibur. Allin off the ropes with a Coffin Drop, but Moxley stabs him in the back with the fork. He tells Garcia to stab Allin the back, and Daniel obliges. They chuck Darby out and in between the cage and ring. Moxley goes outside and gets some of the broken items and a bat. Mark Briscoe WOULD Have been up next, but Renee has an update from the back. She says that the doctor is still looking at Briscoe, and it appears that the attack was brought on by the Don Callis Family. So, it’s 5-on-4 for the Death Riders. While this is going on, Moxley gouges the head of Strong with a broken part of a frame. Garcia hits a piledriver on Allin into broken pieces of glass and shards. Garcia crawls away because his arse landed on the pile too lol. Moxley drags Allin across the broken pieces as we hit another break. Darby is climbing the top of the cage, and he hits a Coffin Drop onto all of the Death Riders. The final member of the Death Riders, the Pants Wearing PAC is here. The bell rings as PAC enters the ring and the cage is locked. O’Reilly tries to neutralize PAC, but PAC takes care of him. Cassidy from the top, but he jumps into the arms of PAC. Yuta takes the key and shoves it in his pants. Good thing no one else is going to go in there to find it, honestly. The Death Riders slow things down now. Yuta holds up Allin while PAC runs the ropes three times before delivering a lariat. MARK BRISCOE is here! He has a toolbox and bolt cutters, as he cuts the chain off and attacks Yuta from the word go. He throws a chair at Garcia. Claudio misses Briscoe and hits PAC, allowing Briscoe to take down Claudio. Moxley on the attack, but Briscoe grabs the toolbox and throws it back in. Yuta grabs onto Briscoe, but Mark hits him with a suplex on the floor. Cassidy attacks PAC with a wrench, while Strong hammers on Moxley with the chain that Yuta brought in earlier. Cassidy with a set of pliers, he hits Moxley in the head with them. He hits him in the gut, but Moxley no sales it and punches away on Cassidy. Yuta has a chair thrown at him by Briscoe, as Mark brings over a table. Briscoe has visions of putting Yuta through the table, but Garcia chokes him out from behind. Mark sets up Garcia on the table instead, and Briscoe climbs the truss. He’s on top of the cage, but Garcia rolls off the table. KOR out and he locks on the cross-arm breaker! Yuta has now joined Briscoe on top of the cage! They trade forearms, and Briscoe has a hook that he sends down the side of the cage. KOR attaches a bunch of chairs to the hook. and Briscoe, after much consternation, pulls the chairs up to the top of the cage! Yuta has one of the chairs, as does Briscoe. Dueling chairs ensue, until Briscoe disarms Yuta and hits him on the back. Briscoe sets up the chairs in a pile, and he wants the Jay Driller, but Yuta with a low blow. Yuta throws a chair into the head of Briscoe as we take our final break of the evening. Yuta and Briscoe are still on top of the cage as we return from break. Yuta looks for the Jay Driller on Mark, but Briscoe returns the low blow favor and hits the Jay Driller for real! Allin is trying to kill Claudio with a hammer, but here is Moxley with his Abdullah the Butcher fork. Briscoe climbs down from the cage, and PAC is waiting to attack him. He sends Briscoe into the barricade, but here comes Allin to attack PAC. Allin throws PAC into the barricade. He has the taser in his hand, but he is attacked from behind by Gabe Kidd ! Kidd chokes Allin and drags him up the stage, with PAC following. Cassidy, meanwhile, will learn in the future to not put his hands in his pockets after he gets them stapled to his lap. Meanwhile, on the stage, Kidd and PAC try to pull Darby up on top of the stage, but Allin fights off Kidd for a bit. Kidd goes backstage and comes back with lighter fluid. HE LIGHTS THE TABLES ON FIRE, AND PAC THROWS CASSIDY OFF THE STAGE AND THROUGH BOTH TABLES!!! AND YET ALLIN WILL NOT SURRENDER! Welp… Back in the ring, Moxley puts the chain around the mouth of O’Reilly and puts on the bulldog choke. O’Reilly flips him off, as Moxley gives up the move for something more sinister. Claudio sets up the chair on the throat of O’Reilly, but OC rolls in like a barrel. He kips up, as Cassidy and Strong hit running elbows. PAC is back at ring side, as Briscoe puts him through a table. Yuta gets put through a table. Cassidy wants the Orange Punch on Moxley, but Claudio intercepts him, so he gets punched instead. Claudio put through the table by Strong! O’Reilly has the ankle lock on! Moxley counters, but O’Reilly with the arm bar! O’Reilly back to the ankle lock! Moxley is in the broken glass! DICTATOR JON GIVES IT UP! WINNER: Darby Allin, Roderick Strong, and the Conglomeration TIME: 54:00 THOUGHTS: Not for nothing, but if the Death Riders had won after the heels won earlier in the Women’s B&G match, it would have been shady AF. But the good guys won, Briscoe overcame being attacked before the match, Darby was involved in more insane shit, and perhaps the most interesting part of it all, Moxley tapped out and lost the match for his group. We’ll see how that plays out moving forward, but as for this match, it was on par with the women’s match, but it had more insane shit going on during it. RATING: ****1/2 The baby faces (sans Darby) celebrate their win, as the Death Riders retreat. And with that, we are done! Ciocco’s AEW Dynamite: Blood & Guts Review 11.12.25 SICKOS! It’s Wednesday, you know what that means! AEW Dynamite is LIVE tonight from Greensboro, North Carolina! And tonight is no ordinary episode of Dynamite, no sir, because tonight, it is all about three words, two rings, and one cage… BLOOD AND GUTS! For the unacquainted, the Blood and Guts setup is somewhat similar to the “what’s old is new again” concept of War Games. Think of WAR GAMES being said in William Bloody Regal’s voice, and it’s set to make it more epic. Now, apply that to BLOOD AND GUTS. Epic, no? This year, not only will be getting the usual Men’s B&G match, but we will also be getting a Women’s B&G match as well! In addition to that, the Women’s match plans to be more chaotic and have more moving parts than the men’s match based on the fact that there will be six women on both teams, as opposed to five on both Men’s teams. As for who is involved, well, in the men’s match, we have the unified front of the Death Riders taking on The Conglomeration, Roderick Strong, and Darby Allin. Given that everyone (most especially the Conglomeration and the armaments aligned with them) is opposed to the Death Riders, this match makes a lot of sense and doesn’t feel thrown together just to have a B&G match. As for the Women’s match, on one side, we will have the Triangle of Madness, Marina Shafir, Megan Bayne, and the holder of every women’s title in the known galaxy save Kris’ title, Mercedes Mone. Standing in opposition of them, we have Jamie Hayter, Willow Nightingale, Harley Cameron, TIMELESS Toni Storm, my future Ex-Wife Mina Shirakawa, and the AEW World Women’s Champion Kris Statlander. Aside from Blood and Guts matches, we will have a Falls Count Anywhere match, pitting the AEW Men’s World Champion Hangman Adam Page against Powerhouse Hobbs. And, although that is all we have seen announced so far officially, I am sure that we will have more in store for us tonight. After all, I have it on good authority that tonight’s show is listed for two and a half hours which, you know, makes sense given the amount of time B&G matches usually get. Plus, clean up and all that fun stuff. Anyway, how are you fine people tonight? I just watched the third episode of IT: Welcome to Derry because I forgot I had it saved to my list on HBO Max. I’ve also gotten into DMV and Shifting Gears, one because it’s hilarious, and the other because it features Kat Dennings. So, enough about all of that, let’s get ready to make the Dynamite go BOOM and witness some blood (and perhaps, yes, guts)! Image Credit: Follow the Revolution – FTR on Facebook. IYKYK Tonight, Blood and Guts Dynamite is LIVE from Greensboro, North Carolina! Excalibur, Tony Schiavone, and Bryan Danielson are on the call tonight! YOU WANTED WAR! How appropriate tonight lol. The arena has went dark. Justin Roberts says this is the first ever Women’s Blood and Guts! These women continue to make history, kick ass, and I (and you) love it! text: Diane Kruger & Jo Joyner in New Mom Thriller 'Little Disasters' Trailer | FirstShowing.net ⌕ HOME TRAILERS 2025 SCHEDULE 2026 SCHEDULE REVIEWS EDITORIALS INTERVIEWS FEATURETTES SHORT FILMS ABOUT TRAILERS Diane Kruger & Jo Joyner in New Mom Thriller 'Little Disasters' Trailer by Alex Billington November 12, 2025 Source: YouTube "You have to protect yourself and the children in case the worst comes to light..." Paramount+ has unveiled an official trailer for a new mini-series titled Little Disasters , adapted from the book of the same name by Sarah Vaughan. This six-part psychological thriller series will premiere all episodes starting in December. When perfect stay-at-home Jess rushes her baby to the ER with a head injury, she's treated by one of her closest friends, Liz. Alarmed by Jess’ behavior, Liz calls social services, triggering an major chain of events – that ripples, fractures and nearly destroys not only their families but also their entire friendship group. Directed by BAFTA nominee Eva Sigurðardóttir ( Good Night, Rainbow Party ), the series pairs realism and suspense to create an intimate yet unnerving portrait of modern motherhood. Anchored by Diane Kruger , the ensemble cast also includes Jo Joyner , Shelley Conn , Emily Taaffe , JJ Feild , Ben Bailey Smith , Patrick Baladi , & Stephen Campbell Moore . This series looks like it gets as intense as the other British parents series Adolescence , but this time focused on mothers feuding with other mothers. It's worth a look. Here's the official trailer (+ poster) for Paramount+'s series Little Disasters , direct from YouTube : The intimate mini-series Little Disasters focuses on a decade-long friendship among Jess (Diane Kruger), Liz (Jo Joyner), Charlotte (Shelley Conn) & Mel (Emily Taaffe), four expectant mothers who were thrown together with little in common apart from their due dates but have been there for one another throughout motherhood. However, when perfect stay-at-home mother Jess takes her baby daughter to hospital with a head injury that she can't explain, her close friend and on-duty ER doctor Liz must make the excruciating decision of whether to call social services. With one phone call, Liz sets in motion a chain of events that ripples, fractures and nearly destroys not only their families but also their entire friendship group. Little Disasters is a series created and written by Ruth Fowler (of "Rules of the Game" series). With additional writing by Amanda Duke; adapted from the bestselling novel by Sarah Vaughan. With episodes directed by Icelandic filmmaker Eva Sigurðardóttir (of the series "Fractures", "Domino Day: Lone Witch"). Executive produced by Marianna Abbotts, Sarah Vaughan, Ash Atalla, Simon Judd, Alex Smith. Paramount will debut Little Disasters streaming on Paramount+ starting December 11th, 2025 coming soon. text: Deadline Print Article deadline-logo-svg Print Diane Krueger-Led ‘Little Disasters’ Sets Up Psychological Thriller With Chaotic Trailer By Rosy Cordero Rosy Cordero Associate Editor, TV @SocialRosy More Stories By Rosy ‘One Piece’ Casts Awdo Awdo & Daisy Head For Season 3 Sean Combs Doc From Curtis “50 Cent” Jackson Sets Netflix Premiere ‘NCIS: Origins’ Casts Shea Buckner As Young Dwayne Pride; Prequel To Round Out Fed Five View All November 12, 2025 3:15pm (L-R): Ed Carrisford (JJ Feild) and Jess Carrisford (Diane Kruger) in 'Little Disasters' Paramount+ Chaos and drama abound in the first trailer for the Paramount+ series Little Disasters , starring Diane Kruger as Jess Carrisford, available above. The limited series premieres on December 11, exclusively on Paramount+ in the U.S., Canada, GSA, Italy and Latin America. The six-part psychological thriller is an adaptation of the Sarah Vaughan novel of the same name by Ruth Fowler and Amanda Duke. The series focuses on a decade-long friendship among Jess (Kruger), Liz (Jo Joyner), Charlotte (Shelley Conn) and Mel (Emily Taaffe), four expectant mothers who were thrown together with little in common apart from their due dates but have been there for one another throughout motherhood. When perfect stay-at-home mother Jess takes her baby daughter to the hospital with a head injury that she can’t explain, her close friend and on-duty ER doctor Liz must make the excruciating decision of whether to call social services. With one phone call, Liz sets in motion a chain of events that ripples, fractures and nearly destroys not only their families but their entire friendship group. JJ Feild, Ben Bailey Smith, Patrick Baladi and Stephen Campbell Moore also star. Executive producers include Ash Atalla, Alex Smith and Marianna Abbotts for Roughcut Television and Sarah Vaughan. Simon Judd executive produces for Fremantle, with Eva Sigurðardóttir directing and Myf Hopkins producing. Watch the trailer above. Videos 2025 Movie Releases Screenings What to Watch Originals Reviews Close Diane Kruger Showcases the "Exhaustion and Depression" of Motherhood in 'Little Disasters' Images [Exclusive] Image via Paramount+ By Britta DeVore Published Nov 15, 2025 Britta DeVore is a Senior Author for Collider who has been known to dabble with Reality News as well. Have you seen stories about ' Chucky ,' 'Scream,' ' Buffy the Vampire Slayer ,' 'The Boys,' 'Vanderpump Rules,' or any of ' The Real Housewives ' franchises? That's probably a Britta DeVore-curated piece of art, and it sounds like you have great taste. When she isn't sitting behind her laptop bringing readers her hot takes on upcoming projects or keeping the dream alive in the Senior News team, Britta can usually be found outside hiking or inside behind her drum set. She currently plays in two bands, Kid Midnight and Watergate, both based in Brooklyn. An obsessive traveler, Britta loves long road trips to the South West and has a soft spot in her heart for canyons, rivers, and forests. She also has a tiny cat named Athena that she loves more than anything else in the world and is always happy for new brewery recs. Sign in to your Collider account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap For everyone out there missing a big dose of book-to-screen drama, your next obsession is on the way. Move over Big Little Lies and We Were Liars , because soon, it will be Paramount+’s time to shine with the upcoming series, Little Disasters . Starring a knock-out lineup of performers that includes Jo Joyner ( Shakespeare & Hathaway: Private Investigators ) and Diane Kruger ( National Treasure ), the six-part psychological thriller that serves as an adaptation of Sarah Vaughan ’s beloved novel of the same name, will drop on the platform on December 11. With each installment arriving at once, the show will be a quick binge to cover over your weekend as you attempt to unravel the secrets hiding within a group of friends. Today, as part of Collider’s Exclusive Preview event, we’ve got two new images from the series that will pull viewers into the chaos. With Kruger front and center, both images show the actress in her happy place — on set and in front of a camera. The first shot captures Kruger standing by herself while, in the foreground, a cameraperson nails the precise angle for the scene. The other photo again gives a little bit of a behind-the-scenes vibe, with a camera rolling and boom mics overhead while Kruger and her co-star, JJ Feild , share an intense scene. When you’re friends with someone long enough, their secrets become yours , and you form a bond that will — hopefully — never break. In Little Disasters , a group of four friends find themselves experiencing one of life’s most beautiful and wondrous moments together — pregnancy. Each of the women is adding a new bundle of joy to their family and is leaning on one another for support, but when one of them (Kruger) takes her baby to the hospital with a head injury, the rumor mill begins churning. Is it possible that the seemingly perfect mom could have harmed her child? As the women begin to search for answers and pick apart their moral obligations, secrets, lies, and deception begin to pop out of the woodwork, threatening everything they’ve built together and then some. Breaking down the key takeaway of what the series looks and feels like to her, Kruger told Collider, “I think Little Disasters is a very realistic depiction of what motherhood, exhaustion, and depression can bring on. It’s something that maybe is not talked about very often. I hope audiences will take that ride with us and find intrigue and compassion… The show explores the friendships between these women who met at a very particular point in their lives and how they manage their families, their careers and where they’re at in life. One thing that really drew me to the show is seeing how they’ve managed to stay friends and how they pull each other up and are there for each other .” Who Else Stars in ‘Little Disasters’? Joining Kruger and Joyner in the twisty-turny drama is an ensemble that includes Shelley Conn ( Gen V ), Emily Taaffe ( The Beast Must Die ), Ben Bailey Smith ( Star Wars: Andor ), Patrick Baladi ( The Hack ), and Stephen Campbell Moore ( Masters of the Air ). Rules of the Game creator, Ruth Fowler, developed the story for television alongside Amanda Duke , with BAFTA nominee Eva Sigurðardóttir ( Rainbow Party ) helming. Sarah Vaughan serves as an executive producer with Ash Atalla , Alex Smith, and Marianna Abbotts for Roughcut Television, as well as Simon Judd under the Fremantle banner, with Myf Hopkins producing. Having already celebrated its arrival earlier this year in the U.K. and Ireland, hype is only continuing to build around Little Disasters ahead of its U.S. arrival in less than one month. Kruger walked the red carpet in an eye-catching sheer lace minidress. In May, Kruger wore a rule-breaking sheer dress to the Cannes Film Festival. Diane Kruger 's latest red carpet look combined two very unlikely styles, and it totally worked. The actress put a Victorian twist on the modern naked dress trend while attending the premiere of her HBO series, The Seduction. Diane Kruger attends the "Merteuil" Premiere on November 12, 2025. Getty Images Kruger walked the red carpet in a sheer lace minidress from the Erdem Spring 2026 collection that featured a high neckline with a ruffled collar, visible boning, and a cage silhouette with a pannier -style skirt. An inscription was embroidered across her chest with a frayed black thread, while pieces of lace trimming trailed down to the floor. Sign in to your MovieWeb account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Making its HBO Max debut on November 14, 2025, The Seduction marks yet another adaptation of the classic French novel, Les Liaisons dangereuses . The best and most famous adaptation remains Stephen Frears' steamy, star-studded 1988 version of Dangerous Liaisons , which was also adapted into a 2022 TV series by the Starz Network. With a slight wrinkle this time, The Seduction serves as a prequel, following the early days of Marquise Isabelle de Merteuil (Anamaria Vartolomei) as she comes of age and learns to wield her seductive power. With new weekly episodes airing every Friday, the six-part historical romantic drama charts Marquise de Merteuil's rise to power, expansive influence, and romantic hold on her suitors in Paris before the French Revolution. For a timeless tale that has been adapted into several languages and media formats, it's worth exploring why Dangerous Liaisons remains so enchanting and how it ties into HBO's The Seduction . How 'The Seduction' Adapts a 243-Year-Old Story Adapted from the 1782 novel Les Liaisons dangereuses by Pierre Choderlos de Laclos, The Seduction chronicles the early days of Marquise Isabelle de Merteuil (Anamaria Vartolomei), a romantically jilted and vengeful aristocrat in 18th-century Paris. To contextualize the prequel, it's best to consider the first major cinematic adaptation of the timeless story, Stephen Frears' stellar 1988 adaptation . In that film, a grown Isabelle (played by Glenn Close in an Oscar-nominated performance) is rejected by her former lover, Comte Bastide, prompting a searing psychosexual drama of seductive manipulation, romantic scheming, and conniving carnality. Vowing to get back at her ex-lover, Isabelle recruits the rakish womanizer Vicomte de Valmont (a never-better John Malkovich), convincing him to seduce one of Bastide's female virgins, Cécile de Volanges (Uma Thurman). Although he lacks scruples, the sexually depraved Valmont rejects Isabelle's offer and begins seducing Madame de Tourvel (Michelle Pfeiffer), a highly pious woman with radiant beauty. Cecil's mother and Isabelle's cousin, Madame de Volanges (Swoosie Kurtz), warns Tourvel to avoid Valmont's lusty advances, prompting Valmont to change his mind and seduce Cécile instead. Further entangling the romantic web of deceit, Valmont's lurid ploy backfires when Cécile meets and falls for the dashing young Chevalier Danceny (Keanu Reeves), plumbing envious feelings that Valmont must navigate. In HBO's The Seduction , the story will predate what transpires in the novel and 1988 movie. The focus will spotlight Isabelle's youthful upbringing and coming of age as she navigates the lascivious culture of Paris in the 1700s, giving the timeless tale a modern feminist twist . Who Stars in 'The Seduction'? HBO Max Although The Seduction will be a prequel to Dangerous Liaisons , many recurring characters appear in the HBO adaptation. French actress Anamaria Vartolomei ( Mickey 17 ) plays Madame Isabelle de Merteuil as a younger, 20-something version of the character. Noée Abita ( My Summer with Irene ) portrays Madame de Tourvel, Fantine Harduin ( Happy End ) plays Cécile de Volanges, and Vincent Lacoste ( Along Came Love ) plays Valmont. Superb German actor Diane Kruger ( Inglourious Basterd s) plays Valmont's aunt, Rosemonde, portrayed by Mildred Natwick in the 1988 film. Written by Jean-Baptiste Delafon ( Of Money and Blood ) and directed by Jessica Palud ( Being Maria ), The Seduction also stars Lucas Bravo as the devious Gercourt ( Emily in Paris ). Julien De Saint Jean ( Love Me Tender ), Juliett Thierry-Mieg ( Wolfpack ), and Patrick d'Assumçao ( The Taste of Things ) also star in the show. Although their roles are unspecified, the supporting cast is sure to prop up the main characters as Isabelle rises to power and becomes an irresistible force within Paris's steamy, polyamorous aristocracy. The Seduction joins several multimedia and multilingual adaptations of the source novel, including Milos Forman's 1989 version, Valmont ; the 1999 American remake, Cruel Intentions (also starring Swoosie Kurtz); the 2022 American TV series Dangerous Liaisons ; the canceled 2024 American TV series Cruel Intentions ; and many more. The story has been adapted in Korean, Colombian, Brazilian, and Czech productions. Now that it returns to its French origins, The Seduction plans to update the story for 21st-century viewers. The Seduction Aims To Update a Timeless Tale for Modern Audiences HBO Max Although the story is set before the events in the novel, The Seduction has a deliberate modern-day focus. According to Jessica Palud, it was important to frame The Seduction as a contemporary take on the #MeToo Movement , telling Variety : " In the book, we understand she [Isabelle] experienced some trauma because she was taken advantage of by Valmont. In 'The Seduction,' we made her much more feminist. You could say that the story of Merteuil is really the #MeToo of the 18th century ." To separate the new HBO Max series from previous adaptations, Palud also created a more fertile dynamic between Isabelle and Valmont's aunt, Rosemonde, adding: " We created a relationship between two women, one who is evolving in this world and ultimately wanted to speak out, but at the same time who is part of the old world, who thinks it’s not possible to go too far and that we can’t surpass men, and who is still trapped in this patriarchal world . We wanted to have a woman who was a bit of an outsider in this group of young people but was still beautiful and looked young. We put some names on the table, and Diane Kruger came up ." Another new addition to the updated prequel is the hedonistic Gercourt, Isabelle's former lover, who plays a prominent role in the novel but is absent from Frears' movie . About casting Lucas Bravo as an insatiable Lothario, Palud stated: " I had never seen 'Emily in Paris,' so I didn’t know anything about Lucas Bravo. I didn’t know him. I saw him at the casting and I found him. I thought this guy had a fabulous evil look. He’s like Captain Hook! It’s a really dark role. He’s a character who has a lot of violence in him ." Regardless of the new plot points and character dynamics, The Seduction is supported by an ageless tale of lewd Libertine lust. Although set in the distant past, Palud is more interested in framing the classic 18th-century story to make a bold statement about today's societal attitudes toward promiscuous sex, the age of consent, bodily autonomy, feminine-masculine power dynamics, and how far civilization has come in the past 250 years. The Seduction will be available to stream on HBO Max on November 14. text: Marlowe review - Liam Neeson wearily treads those mean streets | The Arts Desk Skip to main content thu 27/11/2025 Sections Search today new music opera film classical theatre comedy dance visual arts tv gaming CD/DVDs Books Search form Search Main navigation today new music opera film classical theatre comedy dance visual arts tv gaming cd/dvds books Search Secondary menu reviews features gallery q & a proms first person we recommend Breadcrumb Home Film Marlowe Review - Liam Neeson Wearily Treads Those Mean Streets reviews, news & interviews Marlowe review - Liam Neeson wearily treads those mean streets Neil Jordan leans on threadbare noir pleasures, and his star's burnt-out private eye by Nick Hasted Friday, March 17, 2023 share this article Share Sky UK Neil Jordan’s take on Raymond Chandler’s Philip Marlowe is the first since Bob Rafelson’s Poodle Springs (1998), itself a lone outlier after Michael Winner’s misbegotten The Big Sleep (1978). No one seems to have considered why, or what they might add. Jordan is an Irish magic realist at his best, a gauzy poet around bloody themes. His ambitions here are more modest on an honest job of work. Liam Neeson, his friend and star in Michael Collins and Breakfast On Pluto , wanted to play Marlowe, William Monahan provided a script from John Banville’s Chandler estate-sanctioned novel The Black-Eyed Blonde (2014), and Jordan, hoping to see Neeson smoulder outside his action star shtick, signed on. Chandler invites pastiche, latterly by himself, but his novels’ landmark adaptations dug deeper. Howard Hawks’ The Big Sleep (1946) defined Marlowe when he was new, filming Bogart and Bacall in contemporary LA; Altman’s The Long Goodbye (1973) updated Chandler’s elegiac novel as a farewell to hardboiled and hippie dreams, with Elliott Gould’s Marlowe hip and horrified; Dick Richards’ Farewell, My Lovely (1975) bagged Mitchum’s perfect Marlowe too late for a glowing return to the Forties. Chinatown and sequel The Two Jakes , Blade Runner , Carl Franklin’s Devil in a Blue Dress (1995), with Walter Mosley’s black PI Easy Rawlins flipping Chandler’s racist Forties LA, and Paul Thomas Anderson’s version of Pynchon’s freaky hippie noir , Inherent Vice (2014), did more with Chandler than other straight takes. Still, here’s one more. It's October 1939, a month into Europe’s war. Clare Cavendish (Diane Kruger, pictured above with Neeson) is the blonde who walks into Marlowe’s office wanting to locate her boyfriend Peterson, “a marginal man in motion pictures”. Why taxes Marlowe more than where, as Clare’s wealthy Irish mother Dorothy Quincannon (a cynically sultry Jessica Lange), the manager of the dangerously decadent Corbata Club, Floyd Hanson (wolfish Danny Huston) and gangster Lou Hendricks (waspish Alan Cumming, pictured above ) offer themselves for inspection. The wartime baggage goes nowhere, while themes of Hollywood corruption are sub-James Ellroy, taking little from Chandler’s Hollywood novel The Little Sister , or Jordan’s own studio run-ins. Marlowe gets more background: a stint on the Somme with the Royal Irish Guards, seeing, Jordan says, the worst of humanity. His recalcitrant relationship with authority, his rousting and beating by cops, is gone. Instead, with his DA’s office past played up, he’s drinking buddies with Detectives Ohls (Colm Meaney) and Green (Ian Hart). “You got no regular self-interest that anyone can rely on,” Green says, defining his problem in a town on the take. Pleasures lie mostly in the cast. Neeson at 70 is a dozen years older than Mitchum’s first belated Chandler turn, but his imposing size carries him through the action. His hips have a cowboy swing and his eyes and voice bone-deep weariness, as if he’s been at this much too long. Neeson insisted Marlowe look hopelessly towards a distant woman when Claire enters his office, his character rooted in unattainable romance. The best scene sees Claire attempt seduction and Marlowe, pleading age and more, gently rebuff her with a slow dance to Billie Holiday's “I’ll Be Seeing You”. Kruger isn’t quite invested in her femme fatale , confessing intimidation by Lange’s ripe real thing. The cast and writing’s Irish tilt is interesting, and Irish dance producer and soundtrack sculptor David Holmes’ score atmospherically propels the production with harmonica, brooding brass and jazz double-bass. In a brief moment of real pain, a gospel choir sings over a murdered woman’s ruined body by a river. Jordan finessed Monahan’s script, adding a kink to the denouement which perhaps thoughtlessly sinks Marlowe’s moral purpose. His classical camera restlessly cruises and prowls, switching angles in elegant edits, moving behind pillars and frosted glass, seeking mirrors. Trippy scenes in the Corbata’s bowels as crooner music distorts also let off stylish steam. No one seems to mind the threadbare story, taking the pleasures to be had down these familiar mean streets. Pictures canceled a planned Superman movie in the 2000s, as Christopher Nolan ’s Dark Knight trilogy would have never happened otherwise. Nolan’s Dark Knight trilogy encompasses 2005’s Batman Begins , 2008’s The Dark Knight , and 2012’s The Dark Knight Rises , all of which DC fans widely consider to be some of the best Batman movies ever, especially when it comes to The Dark Knight. Why will Batman fans be glad a Superman movie was canceled? In a recent interview with Empire Magazine , per World of Reel , Nolan revealed that Batman Begins, The Dark Knight, and The Dark Knight Rises only happened after Warner Bros. Pictures canceled a Superman movie that was going to be directed by Wolfgang Petersen. “I was originally hired by Warner Bros. to direct Troy . Wolfgang [Petersen] had developed it, and so when the studio decided not to proceed with his superhero movie [Batman Vs Superman], he wanted it back,” Nolan said. Troy is a 2004 epic historical action film written by David Benioff. The cast of that movie includes Brad Pitt as Achilles, Eric Bana as Hector, Orlando Bloom as Paris, Diane Kruger as Helen, Brian Cox as Agamemnon, Sean Bean as Odysseus, Brendan Gleeson as Menelaus, Rose Byrne as Briseis, Peter O’Toole as Priam, and more. The film was a big box office hit for Warner Bros. and Peterson, as it grossed $497.4 million worldwide. Critical response to the film was mixed, though it did score a nomination for Best Costume Design at the 77th Academy Awards. Nolan is also known for making 1998’s Following, 2000’s Memento, 2002’s Insomnia, 2006’s The Prestige, 2010’s Inception, 2014’s Interstellar, 2017’s Dunkirk, 2020’s Tenet, and 2023’s Oppenheimer. His next movie, The Odyssey, arrives in United States theaters on July 17, 2026. News By JoshWilding - Nov 22, 2025 08:11 AM EST Filed Under: Batman Begins There's a huge amount of excitement among film fans for Christopher Nolan's swords-and-sandals epic The Odyssey , but it turns out that wasn't the first time he almost tackled the genre. Speaking to Empire Magazine (via Variety ), the filmmaker revealed that he was attached to the 2004 film Troy . However, when Warner Bros. decided to hand the project over to Wolfgang Petersen, Nolan was presented with an alternative: 2005's Batman Begins . "I was originally hired by Warner Bros. to direct 'Troy,'" The Dark Knight Trilogy helmer explained. "Wolfgang [Petersen] had developed it, and so when the studio decided not to proceed with his superhero movie ['Batman Vs Superman'], he wanted it back." "At the end of the day, it was a world that I was very interested to explore," Nolan continued. "So it’s been at the back of my mind for a very long time. Certain images, particularly. How I wanted to handle the Trojan horse, things like that." According to writer David S. Goyer, Batman Begins was likely presented to Nolan as a "consolation prize" for the fact that he was pulled off Troy . It was Nolan's take on the Caped Crusader that spawned a hugely successful trilogy. Comprised of three movies, many fans still feel the series ranks among the superhero genre's best offerings. Troy , which starred Brad Pitt, Eric Bana, Orlando Bloom, and Diane Kruger, received mixed reviews but, with such a star-studded cast, still earned almost $500 million worldwide. "As a filmmaker, you’re looking for gaps in cinematic culture, things that haven’t been done before," Nolan later said of tackling The Odyssey . "And what I saw is that all of this great mythological cinematic work that I had grown up with – Ray Harryhausen movies and other things – I’d never seen that done with the sort of weight and credibility that an A-budget and a big Hollywood, IMAX production could do." The cast of The Odyssey includes Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong'o, Anne Hathaway, Charlize Theron, Benny Safdie, Elliot Page, Jon Bernthal, and Mia Goth. "Christopher Nolan’s next film The Odyssey is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX film technology," Universal Pictures revealed last December. "The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to Imax film screens for the first time and opens in theaters everywhere on July 17, 2026." The Odyssey arrives in theaters on July 17, 2026. Share Article Share Article Facebook X LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Email Copy Link Link copied Bookmark Comments By Chris Samuel 13:11, Sat, Nov 22, 2025 Carey Mulligan as Edith Pretty (L) (Image: Netflix, Magnolia Mae Films, Clerkenwell Films) An "outstanding" period drama starring Carey Mulligan is hailed by fans for its "superb" performances. The Dig (2021) is based on John Preston's historical novel of the same name and reimagines events surrounding the real-life 1939 excavation of Sutton Hoo in Suffolk, where a treasure trove of Anglo-Saxon artefacts was discovered. Mulligan plays Edith Pretty a wealthy widow and landowner who hires amateur archeologist Basil Brown ( Ralph Fiennes ) towards curious mounds on her land. Pretty and Brown's central role in the remarkable discovery are true to life, though considerable creative liberties were taken to enhance the drama of the dig. If you love simple stories being told in a beautiful and clear manner, and if you like Archaeology, then this is the film for you. All of the actors have done a wonderful job. A fan who provided an Audience Review on Rotten Tomatoes called it a "very nice telling of a true story about Edith Pretty and the historical find at Sutton-Hoo". Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT "Recommend you spent some time in Wikipedia and research before watching, but its well acted and filmed." Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT Another added: "The movie paces beautifully, maintaining interest, whilst generating a sense of calm representative of the setting. One fan hailed the film as 'outstanding' (Image: Netflix, Magnolia Mae Films, Clerkenwell Films) "The cinematography is gorgeous, with beautiful lighting and compositional choices, and there are several standout shots that stay with you. A wonderful movie." Some criticised the narrative as "dull" though many were taken with its patient approach, and revelling in the beauty of the English countryside. A third said: "The story wouldn't be half as impactful without the outstanding performances of the film's accomplished cast. The Dig might tell a forgettable tale but it's certainly an enjoyable period drama." A fourth added: "Outstanding period piece. Superb performances from Mulligan and Fiennes." The film is Certified Fresh on the site with an 88% score on its Tomatometer, reflecting the percentage of approved critics who have given it a positive review. The Dig is streaming now on Netflix . Share Tweet Email 0 Stay informed with free updates: Sign up to get our news digest — delivered directly to your inbox twice a week. Email Address* It’s been a long time coming, but over the weekend, Laika pulled back the curtain on its next stop-motion epic with a teaser video revealing a breathtaking first look at Wildwood . In the three-minute video, the studio introduces audiences to The General, a majestic golden eagle brought to life with the meticulous artistry that has become Laika’s stock-in-trade. According to the clip, artists hand-crafted more than 9,000 feathers to cover two specialized puppets, one for flight and the other for intricate performance work. Voiced by Honorary Academy Award recipient Angela Bassett, The General rules the skies over a fantasy wilderness with a fierce and fearless presence. Wildwood is directed by Laika president and CEO Travis Knight, whose previous work includes Kubo and the Two Strings and Bumblebee , and who is leading the upcoming theatrical reboot of the He-Man franchise. The film adapts Colin Meloy’s bestselling fantasy novel, illustrated by Carson Ellis. Chris Butler penned the adaptation, continuing his longtime partnership with the studio. Wildwood , like the book its adapted from, follows Prue, an ordinary girl from Portland, Oregon, whose life changes when her baby brother is snatched away by a murder of crows. Her desperate search leads her into the mysterious forest of Wildwood, where magic runs deep and not everything that flies is a friend. Joining Bassett, the film’s remaining voice cast promises plenty of star power. Peyton Elizabeth Lee leads the ensemble, joined by Carey Mulligan, Mahershala Ali, Jacob Tremblay, Awkwafina, Angela Bassett, Jake Johnson, Charlie Day, Amandla Stenberg, Jemaine Clement, Tom Waits, and Richard E. Grant. With this first look, Laika confirms what we’ve long suspected, that Wildwood is one of the key animation titles to track in 2026. What Do You Think?
